news.Title: 10月台股期指漲400點
news.Content:
（中央社台北14日電）台北股市今天終場漲284.52點，收48625.83點。10月台指期以48792點作收，上漲400點，與現貨相較，正價差166.17點。

台灣期貨交易所為近2個月指數期貨契約訂定開盤參考價為，10月期貨48392點、11月期貨48607點。

台股今天終場漲284.52點，收48625.83點，成交金額新台幣9286.24億元。

10月台指期貨以48792點作收，漲400點，成交4萬3404口；11月期貨以48964點作收，漲357點，成交1790口。實際收盤價格以期交所公告為準。1151014

news.Title: 外資專挑尾盤殺？台積電最後一單遭提款近200億元 台股120漲點秒吐回
news.Content:
外資專挑尾盤殺？台積電（2330）今（14）日在最後 5 分鐘撮合時突然遭到賣壓襲擊，爆出7,999張賣單，以今天收盤價估算，金額近200億元，導致股價瞬間由2,505元急甩 15 元，終場以2,490元平盤作收，分析師表示，外資賣的原因都不盡相同，但是好事，只要賣壓消化完畢，股價隔日就會陸續回升。

台積電今天盤中最高觸及2535元，上漲45元，隨後漲勢收斂，但仍守在2500元關卡，不過，突如其來的尾盤賣壓，不僅使台積電失守2500元關卡，也直接拖累台股大盤指數。台股原本盤中大漲逾 441 點，在台積電尾盤甩尾下壓約 120 點後，漲幅大幅收斂，終場上漲 284 點，收在 48,625 點。

針對台積電尾盤爆量急殺，資深台股分析師蔡明翰指出，台積電股東以大量外資與機構法人為主，能一次丟出如此龐大的量能，顯然是特定對象的調節動作，一般散戶投資人根本無法創造這種市場影響力。

蔡明翰分析，這種尾盤爆量屬於特定對象的一次性交易，背後的原因每次都不盡相同，投資人其實不需要過度追究或焦慮，雖然當天收盤看似受到壓抑，但只要賣壓消化完畢，壓抑的股價隔日就會陸續回升、甚至重回原本的趨勢軌道，對長線走勢與整體水位影響有限，因此對於這類尾盤交易無須過度分析與恐慌。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股漲284.52點
news.Content:
（中央社台北14日電）台北股市今天開高震盪，收盤漲284.52點，為48625.83點，漲幅0.59%，成交金額新台幣9286.24億元。

加權指數開盤為48382.64點，盤中最高49059.12點，最低48382.64點；不含金融股指數43328.56點，漲271.63點。

八大類股漲跌幅：泥窯股漲3.95%、食品股漲1.14%、塑化股漲6.64%、紡織股漲2.26%、機電股漲0.33%、造紙股漲1.34%、營建股漲0.35%、金融股漲0.14%。

委買張數2536萬2865張，委賣張數1527萬7509張，成交張數1123萬9427張。

收盤時上漲752家，下跌245家，持平109家。

成交量前5名個股為主動中信台灣收益、友達、國喬、台塑、台玻。

漲幅前5名個股為大毅、全福生技、佳大、台虹、天瀚。

跌幅前5名個股為美德醫療-DR、蔚華科、冠西電、玉晶光、華冠。1151014

news.Title: 台塑三寶強攻，靜待台積電法說會後市場反應
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃俊超】美股道瓊10/13跌0.35%、S&P500下跌0.02%、Nasdaq下跌0.15%、費城半導體下跌0.23%。道瓊指數開高走低，費城半導體指數則是開低走高，四大指數跌幅最終都不算太大。德國股市下跌0.07%、法國股市下跌0.07%。日經指數雖然反彈，不過仍是低於5日與10日均線，日KD指標交叉向下後延伸，觀察20日與60日能否成為支撐力道，韓國綜合指數亦反彈，站回到整數關卡6000點之上，暫時守住240日均線，不過整體表現仍屬相對弱勢，持續觀察7月底低點5262.77點能否有守。中國上證指數短線仍受制5日均線，近期低檔約同於7月中旬低點，試圖在相對低檔打底，均線已為蓋頭反壓，香港恆生指數在短期均線震盪，中長期均線已全面下彎，短線試圖突破20日均線。美元指數來到102~102.5，新台幣貶值來到32.2元，日圓維持156~159。

加權指數開高後震盪，不過尾盤漲幅收斂，終場上漲284.52點、0.59%，收在48625.83點，成交量為9286.24億元，成交量萎縮回到1兆元之下，不過盤中試圖挑戰短期均線，短線技術面觀察49000點與10日均線能否有效站上，日KD指標交叉向下後延伸，日MACD指標柱狀體由紅翻黑。短期受到國際股市與總體經濟干擾相對較深，台股表現已屬相對強勢，指數能否轉強的關鍵，觀察市場對於台積電(2330)法說會後的反應。

櫃檯指數彈升相對強於加權指數，終場上漲5.82點、1.4%，收在420.13點，成交量為2282.38億元，開盤站在20日均線向上挑戰，不過仍要留意5日均線向下交叉10日均線，日KD指標交叉向下後延伸，日MACD指標柱狀體由紅翻黑，短中期均線收斂趨於糾結，觀察重點在於60日均線走平後，轉向上彎力道能否帶來支撐。

台積電尾盤走低收平盤，等待法說會後市場反應，聯發科(2454)跌1.1%，若能站回短期均線之上才利於反彈，台達電(2308)漲0.56%、鴻海(2317)漲1.25%、日月光投控(3711)漲0.95%，金像電(2368)漲7.69%、國巨*(2327)漲4.67%相對較佳，多數電子權值股彈升，其中PCB類股的表現相對整齊且亮眼，傳產權值股以塑化類股表現為佳，台塑(1301)與台化(1326)攻上漲停板，南亞(1303)上漲9.4%。

news.Title: 台股收盤／台股反攻漲284點！櫃買勁揚1.4%　被動、光通訊轉強
news.Content: 美股四大指數全面收黑，費城半導體指數下跌0.23%，加上中國記憶體大廠長鑫存儲技術研發取得進展的市場傳聞，衝擊美光股價重挫3.6%，台股今（14）日仍展現反彈氣勢。加權指數早盤震盪走高，盤中一度逼近4萬9千點關卡，尾盤漲幅收斂，終場上漲284.52點、漲幅0.59%，收在48625.83點，成交金額達9286.24億元；代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步走強，終場上漲5.82點、漲幅1.40%，收420.13點，成交金額2282.38億元。 美股四大指數收黑　台股逆勢反彈284點 美股四大指數全面收黑，其中費城半導體指數下跌0.23%，為台股帶來壓力。權王台積電（2330）收在2490元平盤，市場資金轉向南亞、金像電及國巨等個股，呈現權值股整理、部分電子股強勢表態的格局。 台股今日開盤後展現反彈力道，加權指數盤中震盪走高，隨後高檔震盪，尾盤出現一波明顯賣壓，指數漲幅快速收斂，最終仍守住48600點關卡。櫃買指數則相對強勢，盤中一度拉升後維持高檔震盪，終場上漲1.40%，表現優於集中市場。 倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，儘管中東緊張局勢未除、通膨及長期公債殖利率飆升等逆風干擾，以及高檔獲利了結賣壓與融資清洗賣壓正在同步釋放等因素，仍將牽動著市場敏感神經及追價買盤的意願與力道；不過，大家也無須過於緊張或擔心，在AI人工智慧投資熱潮與企業獲利成長足以支撐台股延續多頭行情，以及下檔在月線及季線有撐下，在在都有利於台股持續震盪向上挺進；因此，在操作策略上，由於台股獲利成長動能主要來自AI相關應用拉貨需求，故投資方向可聚焦Rubin Ultra供應鏈、AI ASIC、以及PCB/CCL、CPO光通訊、高速傳輸連接器、玻纖布暨電子材料、被動元件、先進製程封裝與設備等受惠基礎建設的族群；而台塑集團正展現傳產的華麗轉身，包含電力設施、特用化學等領域，也都可留意；加上隨著年底作夢行情接近，勇於規劃遠景的企業，市場也會肯定；只不過面對關前震盪、個股波動加劇的情況下，對於某些高估值之漲高股，以及產業前景不如預期的公司，不宜貿然搶進。 南亞大漲9.4%領軍　金像電、國巨強勢吸金 從成交值排行觀察，南亞（1303）成為今日盤面焦點，終場收349元，上漲30元、漲幅9.40%，強勢表現吸引市場目光；金像電（2368）同步走高，收1260元，上漲90元、漲幅7.69%，成為電子股強勢代表。 被動元件相關個股國巨*（2327）收627元，上漲28元、漲幅4.67%；台塑（1301）表現同樣亮眼，漲停收88.90元，上漲8元。富喬（1815）收134元，上漲4元、漲幅3.08%，顯示部分電子材料及傳產個股獲得資金青睞。 另外，欣興（3037）收1185元，上漲5元、漲幅0.42%；台塑化（6505）收119.50元，上漲0.50元、漲幅0.42%，均維持紅盤，顯示盤面資金並未全面撤出，反而集中在特定強勢個股。 台積電平盤撐盤　聯發科、大立光逆勢走弱

news.Title: 傳產強勢　台股上漲284.52點收48625.83點
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北14日電）台股今天在傳統產業上揚推升下止跌反彈，尤以台塑集團台塑、南亞和台化股價走勢強勁，加權指數收在48625.83點，上漲284.52點，成交值新台幣9286.24億元。

南亞第3季獲利創新高，今天股價延續強勁走勢，盤中一度攻上漲停，終場收在349元，上漲9.4%，台塑和台化同步收在漲停，推升塑膠類股指數勁揚9.27%，為盤面強勢指標。

水泥、食品、紡織、機電、電纜、玻璃、造紙、鋼鐵、橡膠和汽車類股指數上漲逾1%。電子股終場漲勢收斂，類股指數上漲0.31%。（編輯：潘羿菁）1151014

news.Title: 台積電尾盤遭7999張暴殺！台股收漲284點 台塑四寶2檔漲停
news.Content:
台股今（14日）開高走高，盤中高點觸及49059.12點，重返49K大關，終場上漲284.52點收在48625.83點，成交值9286億元。權值股台積電殺尾盤，爆出7999張賣單下殺至平盤2490元，台達電上漲10元收在1785元，聯發科下跌50元收在4475元，鴻海也漲逾1%收在243元。

台塑集團成為盤面亮點，台塑與台化飆上漲停，南亞也大漲超過9%，台塑化表現平平僅小漲近1%。傳產塑化油電與陶瓷受拉抬，金融股則出現回檔，熱門族群PCB、被動元件、航運及光通訊族群出現反彈。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指出，美股出現明顯資金板塊挪移，市場擔憂AI硬體支出放緩，導致半導體與設備股持續遭到調節。不過資金轉向雲端科技巨頭，顯示AI資金並未全面撤出，而是從硬體轉向大型科技與雲端應用。

展望台股後市，林漢偉認為，台股有望出現跌深反彈，受惠美股科技巨頭回穩、電子權值股跌勢有機會暫時止穩。不過外資現貨大賣、期貨空單大增。今天重點觀察台積電能否帶動指數站回10日線，以及中小型股跌深反彈力道。

news.Title: AI下一波革命來了！ 大摩揭「4大技術戰場」台積電、 聯發科全入列
news.Content:
根據摩根士丹利最新研究報告指出，隨著自主式AI全面驅動推論需求，AI基礎設施正加速轉向機櫃級共同優化。光學互連、先進封裝、記憶體架構與電源散熱已成為四大關鍵技術戰場，全面牽動台積電、聯發科等大中華區半導體供應鏈的未來發展佈局。

光學互連技術升級與挑戰

根據摩根士丹利分析師團隊的研究報告指出，在光學互連方面，共同封裝光學（CPO）正朝向機櫃級規模升級發展，一項64個XPU的CPO運算機櫃展示突顯了加速器之間直接光學連結的潛力。隨著200G/通道的電氣通道逼近物理極限，光學規模升級將變得更加重要，特別是針對客製化XPU。不過，可插拔光學元件憑藉其在維護性與成本上的優勢，仍將保有規模外擴的出貨量領導地位，而封裝良率、光纖對準與可靠性則是主要的商業化挑戰。

聯發科引領3.5D先進封裝

在客製化ASIC與先進封裝領域中，摩根士丹利報告提及聯發科強調客製化ASIC設計正接近10倍光罩尺寸，並認為3.5D整合相較於傳統2.5D互連，可帶來大約10倍的晶片對晶片能源效率提升，管理層預期未來3年至5年內將獲得市場的廣泛採用。同時，聯發科也高度重視客製化HBM、專有晶片對晶片互連以及DTCO優化，隨著系統複雜度持續增加，先進封裝與客製化ASIC設計服務將迎來龐大的結構性商機。

SK海力士革新記憶體架構

在記憶體架構方面，摩根士丹利研究顯示，SK海力士推出了MARS分散式記憶體架構，透過共用KV快取存取來取代重新運算，成功展示首個Token生成時間達到3至5倍的效能改善。此外，HBF的目標是提供大約一半的HBM頻寬但擁有14倍更高的容量，預計於2028年初提供樣品。隨著推論工作負載日益需要涵蓋HBM、DRAM和NAND的異質記憶體架構，記憶體內容有望超越傳統的GPU附加HBM。

電源與散熱面臨系統瓶頸

在電源與熱管理方面，摩根士丹利指出，展示6kW級雙面冷板、垂直電力傳輸以及先進微通道冷卻，突顯出日益嚴峻的散熱挑戰。功率超過200kW的機櫃正加速採用800V直流電，以減少轉換損失並提升功率密度。同時，超微的Helion自主式AI機櫃架構，也在GPU基礎設施之外強化了對CPU的增量需求，使電力傳輸、先進冷卻與系統整合能力成為日益重要的差異化競爭因素。

台廠供應鏈評等

根據摩根士丹利的大中華區半導體產業研究報告，針對多檔關鍵供應鏈個股給予評等與追蹤。其中包括聯發科（2454）、台積電（2330）、日月光投控（3711）、世芯-KY（3661）、南亞科（2408）及聯電（2303）均獲「增持」評等。

news.Title: 施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF聚焦台股科技AI創新，11/2-11/6開募
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】施羅德正式將主動式ETF版圖拓展至台灣市場，施羅德投信今(14)日宣布推出施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF(00419A)，預計11/2-11/6募集，發行價10元，這是施羅德繼澳洲、美國及歐洲既有的主動式ETF管理經驗後，台灣推出施羅德在亞洲首檔聚焦於台灣上市AI及科技價值鏈企業的投資商品。主動施羅德AI台股聚焦投資受惠於AI發展趨勢的台灣企業，掌握台灣AI生態系長期成長機會。投資範圍涵蓋半導體、光通訊、零組件、基礎建設及重電等AI應用領域企業，完整布局AI產業鏈不同發展環節。

延續施羅德主動式資產管理優勢，主動施羅德AI台股結合深耕台股市場多年的在地研究經驗，以及橫跨24個地區、超過650位投資專業人士組成的全球研究平台資源，透過企業基本面分析、AI產業定位評估及競爭力檢視，從超過300檔AI相關企業中精選30檔以上具長期成長潛力的個股納入投資組合。

根據投信投顧公會與臺灣集中保管結算所統計至8月底，目前在台管理資產規模約達5,673億元。施羅德投信董事長謝誠晃表示，台灣不僅是全球科技產業重鎮，也是亞洲最活躍且發展迅速的ETF市場之一；很高興推出施羅德首檔台股主動ETF-00419A，展現施羅德長期深耕台灣市場的承諾，透過創新投資解決方案，協助投資人掌握新的投資機會。

施羅德全球ETF主管Tom Stephen表示，台灣在全球AI生態系中扮演關鍵角色，企業站在半導體創新、數位基礎建設及下一代科技發展的最前線。隨著AI應用加速滲透各產業，施羅德看見整條產業價值鏈蘊含極具吸引力的投資機會。

news.Title: 金融指數逆勢創高 高含「金」量台股ETF受青睞
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 12:40:15 新聞中心 發佈

受到美股費半大跌影響，台股大盤13日開低走低，終場大跌960點，收在48341.31點，跌幅1.95%，4萬9千點大關失守，也讓台股ETF股價跌多漲少。不過，眾多類股指數中，金融指數收紅來到3677.76點並創下新高，也讓15檔持有金融護體的台股ETF績效逆勢收紅。

統計94檔台股ETF中有55檔持有金融類股，其中包括群益台灣精選高息（00919）、元大MSCI金融（0055）、國泰股利精選30（00701）、統一台灣高息動能（00939）、凱基優選30（00938）共有5檔持有金融股五成以上。

進一步統計這些含金量高的台股ETF，在13日大跌之際，包括群益台灣精選高息（00919）、元大台灣價值高息（00940）、國泰永續高股息（00878）、FT臺灣永續高息（00961）、大華優利高填息30（00918）共5檔日均量萬張以上，呈現價量齊揚。

市場法人表示，近期台股電子權值股跌幅較重，短線資金可能轉進金融股避險，當科技類股波動放大時，金融股部位可發揮緩衝效果，建議投資人可留意金融股占比高的台股高息ETF投資契機。

群益投信台股ETF研究團隊指出，市場上每檔台股高息ETF的成分股篩選機制都不同，各有千秋，投資人可依照不同理財目的需求以及配息時間搭配做選擇。而面對大盤震盪，金融股比重較高的配置，在市場快速修正時具一定緩衝效果。此外，相對其他類股，金融股股利與股價表現呈現穩中求勝，高含金量的台股高息ETF，適合穩健型、長期投資的投資人，建議投資人可持有金融股比例高的台股高息ETF。

群益台灣精選高息ETF（00919）經理人謝明志表示，隨著股市來到高檔，部分投資者選擇分散資金至其他評價面合理、營運穩健並具備股息配發潛力的價值股來平衡投資組合風險，金融股便是最為受寵的標的。金融股仍將受惠，在獲利穩健增長下，未來股息配發潛力也備受期待。建議投資人應該關注如何讓自己的投資部位打造穩定現金流，在領息之餘，同時享受資產增值的台股大趨勢。

news.Title: 京元電子證實美國新廠獲NV預付貨款，可望專廠專用，Rubin也上量在即
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】封測大廠京元電子(2449)宣布與NVIDIA簽訂預付貨款合約，此舉無疑證實，京元電已經確認替NVIDIA在美國設置專用的測試廠區，最快今年底～明年初，小型線正式啟動。就營運展望部分，供應鏈也傳出，NVIDIA新款Rubin晶片開始wafer out，並陸續抵達後段封測，京元電業績上的新一輪成長動能將正式開始真正啟動。事實上，近二個月內，關於NVIDIA要投資京元電的消息，早在投資圈與產業圈傳的沸沸揚揚，但目前在製造端，業界與NVIDIA和AMD等大廠的合作協議，多採用預付貨款、客戶買設備等方式，幫助廠商擴產，或是設置專廠專線使用，不涉及股權變化，僅有聯發科(2454)在8月31日宣布的，由NVIDIA斥資35億美元認購聯發科海外可轉換公司債（ECB）。

而京元電剛揭露的與NVIDIA簽訂預付款協議，由NVIDIA提前提供資金，支持京元電美國全資子公司AeternZ在當地建置測試產能，並預留產能供輝達使用。便是現階段NVIDIA供應鏈最常使用也是最簡單的模式。

此一協議的宣布，便證實了京元電已經確認替NVIDIA在美國設廠，新廠區或是新產線將提供NVIDIA專線專用，並透過此協議，確保了京元電在這座美國新廠區的投資壓力大幅減輕，並有獲利的保證，免去很多企業前進美國設廠初期都有龐大虧損的問題，為明智之舉，更是與客戶雙贏的策略。

再就基本營運來看，近期AI圈的大事，便是NVIDIA的Rubin放量與否，這牽動了整個AI供應鏈與機櫃組裝廠的短期表現，市場遲遲等待的Rubin，可望在台積電(2330)召開法說會的本週，開始進入逐步上量階段，預期將可讓第三季表現略低於預期的京元電，在第四季再度可觀的營運成長動能。

news.Title: 台股衝上5萬點？5大公股董座一致看好秒舉手
news.Content:
股市搶搶滾股市！立委羅明才今日質詢問財政部長莊翠雲以及公股銀行董事長，台股會不會上5萬點，5位公股銀董事長看好台股，認為台股指數會站上5萬點。

莊翠雲與9大公股銀行董總今日赴立法院財政委員會備詢。羅明才問，最近股市搶搶滾，是否會站上5萬點？莊翠雲表示，她不是股市預測師「委員比我還專業」，他進一步，公股銀都有自營部門有一些看法，站在台股第一線，台股現在近關情怯，甚至成為外資的提款機。

他進一步公股銀董事長「認為股市會突破5萬點」請舉手？結果土銀董事長何英明、一銀董事長邱月琴、彰銀董事長胡光華、合庫銀董事長林衍茂、台企銀董事長李嘉祥舉手，表達股市會突破5萬點。

羅明才表示，董事長們講的是真話，台灣今年經濟成長率雙位數，幾乎是全世界最高，甚至超越新加坡、日本。台積電上漲1塊錢將牽動台股8點，隨便懂數學一算台股一定會突破2萬點。

5萬點要到了，羅明才表示，很多人來問他要吃什麼？他說，「雞排加珍奶」。不過，他也提醒財長，要注意K型社會，一個雞腿便當從70元漲到130元到150元，漲那麼多大家很辛苦，今年稅收一直成長擁抱AI，生活就會「爽歪歪」，但是很多人生活都吃不飽，怎麼擁抱AI，沒有AI生活就會很「悲哀」。

news.Title: 〈焦點股〉塑化族群紅光滿面 台塑、台化亮燈漲停 南亞寫新天價
news.Content:
台股今(14)日無畏前晚美股收黑，早盤在台積電(2330-TW)等電子權值股領軍下，吹起反攻號角，加上塑化族群今日表現續強，包括台塑(1301-TW)集團的台塑、台化(1326-TW)及南亞(1303-TW)延續昨(13)日強勢行情，開高後量增價揚，迅速亮燈衝上漲停板，南亞更觸及漲停價350.5元創歷史新高，領塑化族群多檔臉紅上揚。

台股在歷經昨日盤中千點跌幅驚魂記後，今日展開反攻行情，盤中一度站回4萬9千點大關，飆漲超過700點。

其中塑化股受惠「金九銀十」旺季行情，盤中除了除了台塑三寶漲停板，集團中的台塑化(6505-TW)也漲逾7.5％。

其他二線塑化股包括國喬及台聚(1312-TW)集團中的台達化(1309)、華夏(1305-TW)、台聚(1304-TW)飆漲超過半根漲停板，中石化(1314-TW)、台苯(1310-TW)、中華化(1727-TW)、亞聚(1308-TW)漲幅也來到有3-4％。

法人表示，受各界對美伊戰爭延燒、全球能源產業何時能恢復正常仍充滿不確定性，加上國際油價居高不下，在AI電子股承受賣壓下，塑化股除了業績亮眼，加上手持轉型題材下，也成為資金避風港。

分析師則指出，目前資金由AI高檔股轉往低基期轉型有成的傳產股輪動，但仍要注意，明(15)日台積電法說會展望後，資金是否再度流向電子股，也提醒近期台塑的融資餘額大幅增加，加上集團集體作帳行情下，投資人切勿追高。

news.Title: 羅明才問台股是否能達5萬點　5家公股行庫董事長舉手認同
news.Content:
（中央社記者呂晏慈台北14日電）國民黨立委羅明才今天在立法院財政委員會質詢時，關注台股加權指數何時能站上5萬點。財政部長莊翠雲回應，她不是股市預測師；羅明才隨後詢問列席的公股金融機構董事長是否看好台股突破5萬點，第一金控、合庫金控、彰化銀行、土地銀行及台灣企銀等5家金融機構董事長皆舉手表示認同。

立法院財政委員會今天邀請莊翠雲率財政部所屬機關首長暨國營事業董事長、總經理列席業務報告，並備質詢。

羅明才質詢時提到，最近台股「強強滾」，台股加權指數何時會站上5萬點。莊翠雲表示，她不是股市的預測師，立委比她更具有這方面的專業。

羅明才表示，台股靠近5萬點「近關情怯」，公股行庫手上都有自營部位，也在市場第一線。他詢問公股金控及銀行董事長們是否認為台股將突破5萬點，並邀請贊成的董事長們舉手。

面對羅明才提問，包括第一金控董事長邱月琴、合庫金控董事長林衍茂、彰化銀行董事長胡光華、土地銀行董事長何英明、台灣企銀董事長李嘉祥等5人都舉手表示贊同。

羅明才指出，今年台股成長幅度大概是全世界最高的，超越新加坡5%、香港3%等，值得好好觀察。而台積電股票漲新台幣1元約等於台股加權指數漲8點，因此他認為台股馬上會突破5萬點。（編輯：潘羿菁）1151014

news.Title: 台股回穩續戰5萬點，聯發科能否轉強、光通訊後市受矚目
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股歷經短線壓回後，週三再度展現回穩力道。其中，台積電(2330)仍維持強勢整理格局，聯發科(2454)則試圖在4,500元附近尋求短線支撐，兩大權值股的後續表現，將是影響台股能否突破5萬點的重要關鍵。　　換言之，台股若要進一步攻上5萬點，除了台積電必須維持強勢之外，聯發科能否重新轉強也相當重要。若聯發科股價能重返5,000元以上，將有助於增添多頭動能，台股挑戰5萬點關卡也可望更進一步。

在此情況下，聯發科旗下的達發(6526)或可扮演領先指標角色，近期股價型態再度轉強，後續表現值得留意。另一方面，光通訊族群短線曾由大立光(3008)及玉晶光(3406)領軍走強，雖然週三在反彈過程中見拉回，但整體多頭趨勢尚未改變。隨著第4季行情持續展開，光通訊仍是市場值得關注的多頭題材之一。

news.Title: 牛市行情反轉？傳奇投資人估2027市況具挑戰性
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 11:20:25 黃智勤 發佈

在1987年「黑色星期一」精準放空的知名基金經理人瓊斯(Paul Tudor Jones)認為，美國股市2027年可能面臨嚴峻考驗，新股發行浪潮及美國財政赤字問題可能顛覆AI驅動的牛市榮景。

MarketWatch等外媒報導，瓊斯指出，2027年對美股將是「極具挑戰性」的一年，面臨2002年以來最不利的資金供需環境，並直言自己計劃在2027全年出手放空美股。他認為，2026年科技巨頭股票發行規模激增，已導致市場資金供需前景轉趨不利。

瓊斯分析，過去四年的美股牛市受到企業股票回購及併購活動支撐，這些活動減少市場流通股票供給，有利股價上漲。然而，大型科技企業陸續上市，加上企業為擴建AI基礎設施而增資籌資，可能使股票供給大幅增加，扭轉過去有利的資金供需環境。

除SpaceX IPO、SK海力士赴美發行股票等重磅事件外，兩大AI新創Anthropic、OpenAI醞釀掛牌上市，可能增加股票供給。瓊斯認為，大量新股發行將吸收市場資金，排擠既有上市公司的投資需求，對股價形成壓力。

高盛最新報告指出，美國企業今年迄今已透過首次公開發行(IPO)、增資、可轉換證券及特殊目的收購公司(SPAC)等管道籌資4,310億美元，預估全年可能達6,750億美元，超越2021年疫情期間市場狂熱創下的歷史高峰。

瓊斯也對美國持續擴大的財政赤字心懷疑慮。他認為，政治人物不會主動透過增稅或削減支出解決赤字問題，最終可能必須等到金融市場施壓，才會迫使政府採取行動。

此外，美伊衝突未解，他預估美國期中選舉後油價可能再上漲每桶20至25美元，進一步加重股市壓力。

瓊斯為知名避險基金經理人，以精準掌握市場轉折聞名，曾在1987年美股崩盤、1990年日本股市泡沫破裂時成功放空大賺。瓊斯已數次示警，這波AI熱潮令人聯想到網路泡沫年代末期，現階段或許還未到高點，但走到修正時可能相當劇烈。

news.Title: 高盛喊買花旗潑冷水 華爾街對股市走向看法分歧
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 10:56:59 李彥瑾 發佈

美股高檔震盪，華爾街對後市看法開始分歧。高盛日前才將全球股市投資評等調升至「加碼」，花旗13日卻澆一大盆冷水，不僅撤回美股「加碼」評等，並將標普500等權重指數的多頭部位平倉。

路透社報導，花旗根據投資人部位、樂觀程度、流動性、槓桿與市場壓力編製的POLLS指標顯示，近期美國股票市場已出現明顯過熱跡象，說明行情反轉的可能性增高，因此決定策略性「適度降低風險」，原有的標普500等權重指數多頭部位平倉。

標普500等權重指數涵蓋與標普500指數相同的500家公司，但每檔個股權重接近一致，較不受大型科技股主導，也更能反映整體市場廣度。

不過，花旗並非全面看空，純粹是認為當前股市情緒偏熱，投資人對利空消息的反應也相對敏感。

相較之下，高盛12日調升全球股市未來三個月投資評等，由「持有」上調至「加碼」，理由是股價回檔讓估值更具吸引力，加上企業獲利有撐，第三季財報季前應視為布局機會。

news.Content:

news.Title: 5165套房學長姐還有救嗎？聯發科連6跌「最慘蒸發69 萬元」 分析師揭止跌訊號
news.Content:
「發哥」連跌六天，套在5,165元高點的學長姐還有救嗎？IC 設計大廠聯發科（2454）今（14）日盤中賣壓湧現，一度下跌50元至4,475元，寫下近一個月盤中新低。統計顯示聯發科已連續走跌六日；若先前進場的4.62萬名新股東買在5,165 元高點，截至今日一張恐已蒸發高達69萬元。 對此，分析師指出，預估要等到股價回測季線約4,250元附近獲得有效支撐，或是成交量重新放大時，才有望止跌回升。

聯發科今天盤中多空拉鋸，開低走高，最高觸及4,550元、上漲25元，但盤中高低震盪達75元，股價由紅翻黑最低觸及4,475元，創下9月17日以來、近一個月的盤中新低。

觀察聯發科自10月5日收盤價5,165元就一路修正，截至今日已連跌 6 天。集保最新統計指出，10月8日聯發科股東人數來到 61 萬 8,964 人，較前一周的57萬2,782人大增4.62萬人；若這些新進股東卡位在 10 月 5 日高點，截至今日每張蒸發69萬元。

針對高檔套牢的「5,165 元學長姐」還有救嗎？國泰證期顧問處協理郭經緯表示，觀察籌碼面，聯發科連跌6天的主因在於「土洋對作」內資投信進場支撐，但外資卻大幅提款，每日賣超高達20億至30億元。

不過，郭經緯強調，若回歸「科斯托蘭尼」的狗與主人理論及產業大趨勢來看，基本面方向並未改變。聯發科目前股價正回測季線（約4,250元附近），距離現價4,500元約還有5%至6%的修正空間。

觀察今日走勢，郭經緯表示，股價呈現「價穩量縮」的止跌訊號。投資人後續可觀察兩大指標：若股價在季線4,250元附近獲得有效支撐，或是成交量落底回升、補量攻擊，都將是行情回穩與佈局的關鍵訊號。

總結來說，郭經緯表示，分析師認為長線大趨勢未變，這波修正屬於外資每天賣超的短線資金調節，等到股價回測季線到4,250元出現支撐，或是成交量重新放大時，這波跌勢才會正式止跌回升。

news.Title: 挾績效冠軍氣勢！它從1800檔台股挖潛力股　3大AI金礦一次打包
news.Content:
深耕台灣近40年的施羅德投信宣布旗下首檔主動式ETF (00419A) 施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF（簡稱：主動施羅德AI台股）。這不僅是施羅德在台灣推出的首檔ETF產品，也代表其多年來深受投資人肯定的台股主動投資實力，正式延伸至ETF市場。

台灣已成為全球AI供應鏈的重要樞紐，相關投資機會遍布半導體、AI基礎建設、光通訊、散熱及新興應用等領域。施羅德投信台股投資團隊表示，在AI浪潮之下，企業表現差異顯著，能否選出真正具競爭力的企業，將是投資成果的關鍵。因此，施羅德希望透過首檔主動式ETF 00419A，將長年累積的研究與選股能力，以更便利且透明的ETF形式提供給投資人。

根據理柏統計至2026年9月底，施羅德台灣樂活中小基金今年以來報酬率達160.5%，於138檔同類型台股基金中排名第一；根據投信投顧公會統計至8月底，基金規模更較年初成長逾七倍。施羅德認為，優異績效來自於深入研究與主動選股能力，而這正是本次推出主動式ETF的重要基礎。

00419A將從台股 1,800 檔個股中，以市值、流動性、財務信評、ESG 等條件篩選投資標的，並聚焦AI半導體、AI基礎建設及AI新應用等領域，打造高信念投資組合。透過主動式操作與動態調整，希望協助投資人一站買齊 AI 半導體，掌握AI產業長期發展趨勢與關鍵投資機會。

展望第四季，施羅德投信台股投資團隊表示， AI仍是電子產業中成長能見度最高的主軸。隨著 NVIDIA 新平台陸續出貨，以及各大雲端業者持續擴大 AI 基礎建設投資，相關供應鏈企業的訂單能見度已延伸至 2027 年甚至更久，成長動能相較傳統消費性電子更具優勢。

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股絕地反攻漲逾600點直逼4萬9 分析師「樂看收漲」：拉回站買
news.Content:
台股今日迎來反彈，最高觸及48964、漲逾600點，一度逼近4萬9大關。大來國際分析師童奕霆指出，今日收漲機率是相對高的，因為今晚將迎來CPI，而明天又有台積電法說，目前的預估量來看是有機會達到8000億元，量縮觀望算是非常合理，在日格局多方架構延續的情況之下，拉回站在買方會是比較合適的作法。

今日值班分析師： 大來國際分析師童奕霆

童奕霆認為，今日收漲機率是相對高的，原因是目前台指期貨1小時K的部份已經回踩到密集成交區，表示這邊會是多數人的成本點位，也是為何夜盤會反彈的原因。

其中若以回測來看，第四季低點有六成機率是出現在10月，因此在日格局多方架構延續的情況之下，拉回站在買方會是比較合適的作法。

而量能的部份，童奕霆指出，因為今晚將迎來CPI，而明天又有台積電法說，因此量縮觀望其實算是非常合理；而若以5日均量來看目前約莫是落在8300億左右，以目前的預估量來看是有機會達到8000億的水準，因此整體量能都還算相對樂觀。

操作方面會建議大家可以往具漲價題材或是大廠合作的公司來做選擇，例如台虹(8039)、台郡(6269)有打進NVLink PTFE Board合作夥伴。而漲價的部份昨天CCL大廠建滔再次喊漲，相關台光電(2383)、富喬(1815)、南亞(1303)亦可同步留意。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉台積電攜塑化跟上亞股反彈腳步 漲逾500點重回48900關卡
news.Content:

news.Title: 傳奇投資人重話警告！股市進入最痛苦一年 小心3大地雷
news.Content:
美國傳奇投資者瓊斯（Paul Tudor Jones）為2027年的股市發展敲響警鐘，警告美股即將進入數十年來最具挑戰性的一年，面臨多重不利因素，嚴峻程度堪比網路泡沫破裂時期。

短多長空 明年壓力大

綜合外媒報導，瓊斯對於股市中長期的看法偏保守，但短期上仍抱持正面態度，「從歷史數據觀察，期中選舉年，往往會在10月觸底，隨後在年底出現強勁收官。」

然而，進入2027年，美股進入更艱難的資金流入環境。瓊斯指出，在過去四年的多頭市場中，企業回購以及併購使股市維持順風，因為它們減少了股票供應，推高股票價格。

如今，市場情勢已經有所轉變，隨著更多企業上市、二次發行的操作增加，當股權供應量上升，價格勢必受到壓抑。瓊斯認為，資金流入股市的前景是2009年以來最糟糕。

該如何操作？早已準備放空

除此之外，瓊斯提到，目前的市場狀況與1999年相似，市場呈現極端兩極化，受益於人工智慧的公司蓬勃發展，且K型經濟趨勢也與當時如出一轍，「我們走上短期內可能表現亮眼，但長遠看來未必有益處的道路。」

瓊斯也警告不斷膨脹的財政赤字帶來的風險，股市可能會因此受到衝擊，「只有等到事情發生了，我們才有機會解決赤字問題，因為沒有任何政客會主動增稅或削減支出。」

市場已經接近臨界點，瓊斯預估發生的機率高達60%，如果期中選舉結束，國際油價可能再上漲20至25美元，屆時股市就會變得極端險惡，「我會選擇放空一整年，當市場供給量增加，價格勢必下跌。」

news.Title: 外資喊到4410元天價！台積電一甩連4跌 漲45元重返2500元關卡
news.Content:
外資相繼上調台積電目標價，市場喊價甚至衝上3,088元至4,410元天價，台積電（2330）今（14）日一甩連四日下跌陰霾，盤中最高觸及2,510 元，上漲45元，來到2535元，成功重返2,500元關卡，分析師表示，台積電短線偏多看待，股價回測至月線，約2,487元附近皆為不錯的低接買點。

美股周二收低，晶片股持續承壓，市場也在評估花旗等美國大型銀行喜憂參半的季度業績，使費城半導體指數下跌 0.23%，連續5個交易日走低。個股方面，台積電ADR則逆勢微漲 0.17%，受此激勵，台積電台北現股今盤中上漲45元，摩爾投顧分析師莊佳螢指出，台積電強勢反彈的主因在於本周四法說會前的利多加持。

莊佳螢指出，剛公布的9月及第三季營收雙雙改寫歷史新高，優於公司先前法說會的高標預期，顯示先進製程產能利用率極強。前幾日股價拉回主要是受美股震盪影響，但在AI基礎建設持續擴張下，客戶對3奈米、2奈米先進製程及 CoWoS 先進封裝的需求強勁，長線基本面趨勢十分明確。 此外，營收公布後，各大外資紛紛調升目標價：摩根士丹利（大摩）上修至3,088元、高盛調至3,300元，花旗環球與麥格理更分別喊出 4,000 元及 4,410 元新天價，外資圈普遍看好台積電長線動能。

台積電法說會明天就要登場，莊佳螢也表示，本季法說會重點將聚焦於第三季毛利率能否衝破65%至67%、第四季營運展望、2奈米擴產進度及先進封裝資本支出的變化。 莊佳螢表示，台積電短線偏多看待，股價回測至月線（約2,487元）附近皆為不錯的低接買點，在月線有守的情況下，法說會前若有拉回均可擇優布局。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台積電狂拉45元！台股反彈近600點 後市2大觀察重點
news.Content:
09:31更新：大型權值股重新獲得資金青睞，台積電與台達電皆上漲超過1%，帶動台股大盤勁揚將近600點。

隨著美股與日韓股市回穩，台股今（14日）以48382.64點開出，隨後上漲超過350點，權值股台積電漲20元觸及2510元，聯發科4525元平盤開出，台達電漲30元觸及1805元，鴻海也回穩小漲2元觸及242元，記憶體、PCB及CCL等熱門族群皆紅盤開出。

台股昨（13日）出現劇烈回檔，終場下跌960.65點收在48341.31點，成交值1兆1250.06億元。三大法人合計賣超1984.46億元，寫下史上第四大賣超規模。自營商賣超569.76億元，投信買超238.72億元，外資及陸資賣超1653.42億元，創下外資單日賣超金額第三大。

展望台股後市，林漢偉認為，台股有望出現跌深反彈，受惠美股科技巨頭回穩、電子權值股跌勢有機會暫時止穩。不過外資現貨大賣、期貨空單大增。今天重點觀察台積電能否帶動指數站回10日線，以及中小型股跌深反彈力道。

news.Title: 記憶體吃緊至少持續至2028年、標普調升鎧俠評等
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 09:05:05 蔡承啟 發佈

記憶體供需吃緊情況有可能至少持續至2028年，美國信用評等機構標準普爾(S&P Global Ratings、以下稱標普)調升日本NAND Flash大廠鎧俠(Kioxia)評等。鎧俠今日股價聞訊強彈。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間14日上午8點50分為止，鎧俠勁揚1.88%至15,465日圓。鎧俠股價昨日(13日)暴跌13%。

標普13日於日股盤後發布新聞稿宣布，將鎧俠長期公司信用評等從原先的「BBB-」調升1個等級至「BBB」、展望為「正向」。標普指出，在強勁的記憶體市況加持下，預估鎧俠未來約2年的獲利能力將維持在遠超標普原先預期的極為強勁水準。

標普表示，AI市場成長，帶動NAND Flash及SSD市況極為良好，鎧俠將受惠。標普預估，當前飆漲的記憶體價格，未來1-2年仍將居高不下。標普指出，儘管各家記憶體廠商持續增產，但供需吃緊的情況很可能至少持續至2028年。

標普表示，藉由和客戶簽訂長期供貨契約，「鎧俠獲利波動性降低的可能性升高」。

日媒報導，鎧俠9月3日舉行了記憶體相關技術說明會，計畫藉由加深和美國科技大廠的合作關係，對抗中國廠商，鎧俠負責記憶體技術的松寺克樹表示，「NAND Flash需求正以前所未見的速度呈現增長」。

鎧俠、Sandisk 8月27日宣布，在獲得日本政府援助的前提下，將在未來6年內(2032年之前)在日本投資約5兆日圓(超過310億美元)。此次的投資將依據市場動向，持續對四日市工廠(三重縣四日市市)和北上工廠(岩手縣北上市)進行設備投資並強化相關基礎設施和技術。

鎧俠8月27日宣布，為了擴增3D NAND Flash「BiCS FLASH」產能，將在北上工廠內興建第3廠房(K3)。K3將位於2025年9月投產的第2廠房(K2)的南側，目標在2029年度投產。

news.Title: 台積電ADR連五黑後小彈0.17%，週四財報登場，市場估Q3獲利再創高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】全球晶圓代工龍頭台積電ADR(美股代碼TSM)週二(13日)在連續五個交易日下跌後，股價呈現低檔震盪格局，盤中一度跌破440美元，隨後出現承接買盤，終場小漲0.17%。隨著台積電(2330)將於週四(15日)公布第三季財報，市場關注強勁AI需求能否支撐獲利持續創高，並扭轉近期半導體類股的修正壓力。台積電ADR在10月5日收在485.80美元的史上新高後，連續五個交易日大跌41.45美元或8.53%後，週二一度追低1.56%至437.40美元的日低，終場小漲0.77美元或0.17%至445.12美元，日高在447.11美元。連五黑急吐逾8%，反映半導體類股近期面臨高檔獲利了結賣壓。中國長鑫存儲宣布下一代記憶體技術取得突破，也加深市場對全球晶片產業競爭的疑慮。不過，台積電主要從事先進晶圓代工，與記憶體製造商的產品定位不同，相關消息對其基本面的直接衝擊相對有限。

基本面方面，台積電日前公布第三季營收達新台幣1.49兆元，年增約50%，創歷史新高，優於市場預估的1.46兆元。根據路透最新調查，分析師預估第三季淨利可望年增約65%至7,463億元，若符合預期，將連續第六季刷新獲利紀錄。AI加速器需求持續強勁，輝達、蘋果等主要客戶對先進製程的需求，以及CoWoS先進封裝產能擴張，仍是支撐營運成長的重要動力。

台積電預定週四下午2時召開法說會，除公布第三季獲利外，也將提出第四季營運展望。市場關注重點包括2奈米製程量產進度、先進封裝供需、毛利率變化及海外擴廠成本。由於台積電股價此前已累積可觀漲幅，即使財報優於預期，投資人仍將檢視公司對2027年AI需求及資本支出的最新看法，判斷財報利多能否帶動股價重拾升勢，或出現利多出盡的獲利了結賣壓。

news.Title: 晶片股行情受挫，艾司摩爾指引成為提振市場信心關鍵
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，艾司摩爾控股(ASML Holding NV)有關產能擴張的指引已成為這家荷蘭公司財報日的一項關鍵關注點，而這一次尤為重要，因為隨著晶片股漲勢遇挫，投資者正尋求能夠提振信心的信號。在上半年表現亮眼之後，半導體股的熱度已經降溫。未來48小時，投資者將寄望於艾司摩爾及其重要客戶台積電，希望兩家公司能夠為市場注入一些信心。

艾司摩爾將於週三開盤前公佈業績，市場最關注的是，該公司對於如何滿足強勁的晶片製造設備需求有何展望，尤其是在艾司摩爾已不再公佈季度訂單數據的情況下。台積電將在週四公佈業績。

Quilter Cheviot科技研究主管Ben Barringer表示，市場現在關注的就是產能。在看不到訂單數據、對積壓訂單情況了解也有限的情況下，艾司摩爾以某種形式上調產能目標非常重要。

艾司摩爾已停止公佈季度訂單數據，理由是訂單具有波動較大、分布不均的特點。不過，該公司已開始提供今年及以後預計生產的設備數量指引。投資者越發利用這一指標來衡量需求強度，以及艾司摩爾擴大供應能力的程度。

艾司摩爾7月表示，計畫明年將其第二先進的設備，也就是低數值孔徑(low-NA)極紫外光刻機的產能提高30%，這將使其年度出貨目標增至85台。

艾司摩爾每台Low-NA設備的售價約為2億歐元(2.23億美元)，從下單到交付需要一年多時間。該公司7月表示，正努力將工廠生產和測試光刻設備所需的時間縮短約三分之一。

但對於2028年，情況存在更大不確定性。艾司摩爾表示，正在「研究」再將產能提高30%是否可行，但尚未明確承諾實現約110台的產能目標。

分析師總體上更為樂觀。瑞銀集團認為，艾司摩爾明年和後年的產能增幅都可能超過30%。摩根士丹利預計，艾司摩爾2027年的設備交付量將超過90台。

Bernstein的David Dai在電子郵件中表示，如果客戶需求更高，他們有能力上調產能數字。不過，艾司摩爾目前可能會維持指引不變，三個月後再上調，因為屆時「需求情況會清晰得多」。

Aviva Investors全球股票分析師Josep Bori表示，艾司摩爾和台積電在擴大供應方面似乎都比較謹慎，因為「他們過去曾有過教訓」。他認為，如果艾司摩爾因未上調指引而遭到拋售，將是增持該股的機會。

news.Title: 長鑫宣布年底量產4F² DDR5，伺服器DRAM競爭恐添變數
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-14 08:36:34 數位內容中心 發佈

- 長鑫存儲宣布計劃在年底前推出採4F²架構的伺服器級DDR5 RDIMM，消息發布當日，三星電子與SK海力士股價盤中分別重挫逾8%與逾10%，韓股大盤也跌破6,000點[1]。

- 最大限制仍在技術與量產節奏：從設備進場到達到可商用良率，往往需要數季甚至數年；美國與盟國的設備出口管制、既有長約與HBM轉產，也都壓縮短期位元釋出空間[2][3][4]。

- 接下來要看長鑫是否公布試產良率、取樣客戶與交期證明，以及國際大客戶與三大記憶體廠如何調整合約與產能配置（含HBM與DDR）[1][5][6]。

長鑫10月13日對外宣稱，將於年底前量產採4F²新世代架構的伺服器級DDR5 RDIMM，消息一出便引發資本市場震盪：當日盤中，三星電子與SK海力士股價分別重挫逾8%與逾10%，並拖累韓股大盤跌破6,000點，反映投資人擔憂高階DRAM競爭格局可能出現變化[1]。之所以牽動市場情緒，在於4F²理論上可將記憶體單元面積縮小約三分之一；相較當前主流的6F²，在相同晶圓面積下可生產更多位元。若再搭配足夠良率與產能放量，將直接壓低每位元成本，擴大供給選項，對伺服器記憶體定價與市占形成潛在壓力[1]。

長鑫喊出量產時程，市場先反映競爭壓力

市場的劇烈反應，反映出投資人對中國廠能否快速把高密度製程推向商用高度敏感。短期來看，這項消息也放大了既有供需緊張的氣氛：過去數季，三大記憶體廠已將部分晶圓資源轉向AI用、高耗位元的HBM（含HBM4），以滿足加速器需求，導致傳統DRAM位元供給相對吃緊；當市場接收到新增供應者的訊號，便會迅速重估價格與市占前景[7][5]。此外，HBM生產對晶圓投入的折損較高，也限制了短期內從HBM回補DDR市場的彈性[8]。

不過，這項宣示是否真能改變高階伺服器位元結構，仍取決於長鑫能否拿出可驗證的量產證據。業界長期觀察到，從設備進駐到穩定量產、達到可商用良率，往往需要數季甚至數年；對中國廠而言，要跨入高密度DDR5領域，良率、測試與封裝能力的缺口尤其不容忽視[2][3]。目前市場的恐慌，更多是對未來供給路徑的重新定價，而非供給已經出現實質改變[1]。

量產良率、出口管制與既有合約都不是短期能跨過的門檻

第一道門檻是技術與良率。若要讓4F²真正成為可交易的伺服器RDIMM來源，長鑫必須公布試產良率、首批取樣客戶與交期證明；否則，這項宣布仍只是潛在變數，還談不上已實現的供給。業界經驗顯示，即使有新製程設計，實際量產良率的建立仍牽涉設備調校、製程修正與測試流程等工程問題，短期內很難完成大規模位元供應轉移[2][3]。

第二道門檻是地緣政治與供應鏈管制。美國與盟國對高階半導體設備及製造關鍵技術的出口審查，已成為常態；這不僅影響中國廠取得關鍵製造工具，也會對其在國際市場取得認證與通路形成實質障礙。即便技術可行，設備與外部驗證能否到位，仍是能否打入全球伺服器供應鏈的重要變數[4][9]。

第三道限制來自競爭對手與既有合約。三星、SK海力士與Micron並非只能被動應對：雖然部分晶圓資源已轉向HBM，但業者也正透過提高RDIMM密度、推進先進封裝，例如512GB RDIMM與TSV垂直堆疊，來鞏固伺服器市場的議價能力；再加上長約與合約供貨體系，既有供應商短期內仍有防線[7][6]。因此，即便市場出現新的可能供應者，是否真能撼動市占與定價，仍有待觀察。

接下來要看的不是說法，而是客戶、良率與交貨證明

現階段最直接的驗證訊號，包括長鑫何時公布試產良率數據、是否披露首批取樣或合作客戶，以及能否在美國與歐洲市場取得關鍵認證與通路。若這些證據能在可檢驗的時間內陸續出現，市場勢必重新評估未來位元供給基準；反之，在缺乏可驗證資料的情況下，眼前的價格波動更可能只是短期情緒反應[1][3]。

同時，也要留意三大記憶體廠的實際應對：是否調整HBM與DDR的產能配置以維持伺服器端供給，或透過產品升級與長約策略，抵消潛在競爭壓力[5][6]。此外，國際政策與出口管制若有任何變化，也可能迅速改變長鑫取得關鍵工具與市場通路的可行性[4]。

市場今天的大跌，顯示投資人已將「中國高階DRAM能否快速商用化」與「三大廠是否可能失去定價主導權」視為後續走勢的重要變數。

news.Title: 【統一證券晨訊】台股守穩月線上震盪　靜待台積電法說

台股受外部利空回測月線，靜待台積電法說會利多突圍

◎昨日盤勢

中東衝突再度升溫，布蘭特原油突破106美元，影響美國科技指數走弱，中

國記憶體廠宣布技術突破，拖累美光及韓國記憶體股重挫，引發韓股盤中一度跌

幅逾7%，連帶拖累周二台股跳空開低下跌，台積電、台光電等AI電子股遭遇賣壓

，加權指數下跌1.95%，失守10日線並回測月線附近，OTC指數則重挫逾3%。盤面

資金轉往金融及傳產族群，台塑集團前三季繳出亮眼獲利，受到資金青睞，台塑

化強勢亮燈漲停表現強勢。電子股部分僅部分光學鏡頭切入光通訊題材的玉晶光

及中揚光受到資金追捧，股價亮燈漲停。權值股方面，台積電下跌1.97%、鴻海

、美好證等共24檔個股漲停；力致、敦陽科、冠西電、美德醫療-DR、南六、大

，電子下跌2.63%、傳產上漲0.73%、金融上漲1.13%。在次族群方面，以油電燃

氣、塑膠、資訊服務表現較佳，分別上漲8.67%、3.90%、1.52%。

大金、合庫金、長榮航；賣超前五大為力積電、友達、南亞科、華邦電、台積電

子83.31%、傳產14.18%、金融2.51%。

◎今日盤勢分析

。原油市場部分，布蘭特原油下跌、紐約輕原油小漲，中東及俄烏地緣衝突仍牽

動原油後續走勢；美股部分，花旗、高盛、富國與摩根大通財報多優於預期但股

價仍回落，晶片股受記憶體類股拖累則延續近期跌勢，然蘋果盤中再創新高。週

二美股四大指數同步下跌，台積電ADR上漲0.17%，台指期夜盤上漲363點，預期

今大盤將守穩月線之上震盪。

台股後市分析如下：第一、旺季效應持續發酵，上市櫃公司9月營收一舉攻

上6.6兆元歷史新高，若加計延後公告的15家金融保險公司的推估數，整體9月營

收上看6.79兆元，推升單月、單季及累計前三季營收齊繳亮眼成績，同步刷新歷

史紀錄。

第二、台灣電池協會表示，企業對自用發電與儲能關注升溫，市場焦點轉向

投資效益、系統安全、維運管理等整體規劃，台灣電池協會將於10月14日至16日

參與2026台灣國際智慧能源週，攜手六家會員共同展出，從關鍵材料與零組件、

電芯模組，一路延伸至電源管理、系統應用、測試驗證及回收循環，涵蓋電池產

業鏈不同環節，展現更完整的產業整合發展。

第三、技術面觀察，週二加權指數出現量增黑K，收盤跌破10日線，指標方

面，KD及RSI持續向下，MACD紅柱微幅縮小，技術面呈現漲多整理，月線為短線

重要支撐，後續靜待費半指穩及台積電法說會利多來扭轉頹勢。

四、盤面資金聚焦台塑集團、小塑化及部分光學鏡頭等族群，包括台塑化、

國喬、玉晶光、中揚光等表現強勢。

◎投資策略

儘管美債殖利率及布蘭特原油回落，然美股仍遭遇賣壓，費半指數連5日收

黑，市場關注週三晚上公布CPI數據，將牽動FED升息路徑；台股受費半及韓股連

續走弱拖累，目前技術面陷入整理，靜待本週台積電法說會釋出利多後來扭轉頹

勢。另外本週OCP全球峰會、美西半導體展、Anthropic投資者日及下週TPCA展接

棒登場，有利低檔買盤支撐，預期指數守穩月線之上震盪，建議逢回布局，AI概

念及業績題材股，搭配短期營收動能股，長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進封測、半

導體設備、PCB、光傳輸、散熱、連接器、貨櫃散裝、塑化及特用化學等。

news.Title: 折價逾20%！激進避險基金Palliser：三星應發行ADR以回購優先股
news.Content:
英國激進避險基金Palliser Capital最新呼籲南韓三星電子以溢價發行美國存託憑證(ADR)，並將籌得資金用於進一步回購、註銷無表決權優先股，藉此縮小其相對普通股的折價。優先股通常股息略高但無表決權，逾百家韓企發行此類證券，整體平均折價更深，成為「韓國折價」與治理改革的焦點。

Palliser創辦人兼投資長James Smith在投資會議上表示，優先股折價是被忽視的公司治理與資本配置異常，解決後可提升資本效率、釋放各類股份價值，也有助增強南韓資本市場改革可信度。

目前，三星優先股在韓股折價超過20%。市場資料顯示，價差曾一度擴至約26%至37%的十年高點，近期因回購預期略有縮小。

今年8月，三星公布2026年股東回報計畫，規模90兆至110兆韓元、約800億美元，創韓企紀錄，其中包含第三季約30兆韓元現金股息、15兆韓元回購供員工薪酬，剩餘回購與註銷細節待董事會討論。

分析人士指出，回購優先股成本較低，也可避開金融關聯方持有有表決權普通股10%上限，降低觸發減持的風險。

Palliser建議，若以ADR溢價募資並專用於注銷優先股，可同時提振EPS、縮小價差。三星則未承諾採納該方案，僅稱回購是多重工具之一，最終規模與品類將視現金流、AI景氣及董事會決策而定。

在南韓政府提升公司價值計畫、商法庫藏股改革推進下，三星如何分配創紀錄回報，將成外資評估韓股治理改善的重要指標。

news.Title: Skyworks (SWKS) Pays 147% of Earnings as Dividends With Over 29% of Its Float Short. Can the Dividend Hold?
news.Content:
Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: SWKS ) closed at $76.56 on October 13. The stock has returned 35.5% over the last six months, compared to a 21.5% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 14% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust.

The payout ratio moved because the denominator collapsed, not because the dividend rose. Skyworks sells components that sit inside other companies' phones, so its revenue is decided in design meetings it does not attend. Everything difficult about owning this stock follows from that one fact.

SWKS ranked 11th in our list of the 11 Best 5G Stocks to Buy Now . To see which stocks outranked it, click HERE .

The Dividend Is Covered by Cash, Not by Earnings:

Earnings fell 67.70% in the most recent quarter while revenue fell only 3.10%, which is operating leverage running hard in reverse at a company with a large fixed cost base. That collapse in profit is what produced a payout above a hundred and forty percent of earnings. The dividend itself did not change.

What keeps it payable is cash. Free cash flow comfortably exceeded reported net income, which is the measure that matters for a distribution and the one the payout ratio ignores entirely. The balance sheet is not the constraint either, because cash slightly exceeds total debt and the current ratio is above three, which is a genuinely conservative position for a semiconductor company. A payout ratio measures earnings while this dividend is paid out of cash, a distinction that matters more across the chipmakers billionaires concentrated on than almost anywhere. The one they bought most of is up 18% since June.

The competitive picture also changed on October 5, when Skyworks completed its combination with Qorvo. Removing its closest rival in radio frequency chips improves the bargaining position of what remains, and management expects at least half a billion dollars of annual cost savings within three years.

DON'T MISS: 10 Most Undervalued Quality Stocks to Invest In

Who Actually Decides Skyworks' Revenue:

Short interest of 29.32% is among the highest in the sector, and the concern behind it is specific rather than general. A radio frequency chip supplier depends on a small number of handset programmes, and losing content in one phone generation moves revenue in a way no cost programme can offset.

That is the whole risk, and it is not hypothetical. The recent revenue decline reflects exactly this dynamic.

The multiples show the market pricing a recovery rather than a decline. The stock trades at 13.40 times forward against a trailing figure near forty-two, which requires earnings per share to roughly triple to $5.70.

Story Continues

A forward multiple deserves the most scepticism in exactly this kind of business, because handset demand is cyclical and consensus forecasts are least reliable when cycles turn. Every figure here describes Skyworks on its own, since the merger closed after the last reported quarter, and guidance for the combined company arrives with the November results. A forecast is an assumption, and handset cycles are where assumptions break, which is why a buyer is usually better served by the quality businesses still available at a discount .

The Valuation Case:

The verdict is that Skyworks looks cheap only if the recovery in the forward estimate actually arrives, and fully valued if it does not. The trailing figure reflects a trough and the forward figure reflects an assumption rather than a commitment. The balance sheet buys time to find out, which is worth something, because a company with net cash and a strong current ratio can wait through a weak handset cycle without issuing equity. What actually delivered is a fair check on what a forward estimate is worth, and on that score the stocks we tipped for high returns read better, with the top name up 24% since January.

Conclusion:

The dividend is safer than the payout ratio suggests and the business is weaker than the dividend implies. Free cash flow comfortably covers the distribution, cash exceeds total debt, and the balance sheet is conservative. However, earnings collapsed on a small revenue decline. A large share of the float is sold short, and the forward multiple requires earnings per share to roughly triple. A handset supplier that loses content in one generation rarely wins it back, so revenue is the only line that matters here.

Market Sentiment:

Skyworks Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:SWKS) was held by 35 hedge funds with a combined stake value of about $1.52 billion at the end of Q2 2026 in the Insider Monkey database. This is level with 35 hedge fund holders with a cumulative investment value of around $1.40 billion in the previous quarter.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of SWKS as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. If you are looking for an AI stock that is more promising than SWKS and that has 10,000% upside potential, check out our report about this cheapest AI stock .

news.Title: Arm shares fall after jury rules in favor of Qualcomm in license dispute
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Arm Holdings shares erased gains and dropped over 3% on Tuesday after a Delaware jury ruled against the company in a breach of contract case brought by Qualcomm.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

The jury found that Arm breached its architectural license agreement with Qualcomm, failed to honor its commitments, and intentionally acted to disrupt Qualcomm's business operations, according to a statement from Qualcomm.

The verdict, dated October 13, 2026, represents another legal setback for Arm in its ongoing dispute with the smartphone chipmaker. Qualcomm called the ruling a win for innovation and competition.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

Qualcomm did not disclose whether the jury awarded damages in connection with the verdict.

Shares of Qualcomm briefly spiked higher and were trading up 2% on Tuesday following the announcement.

The legal dispute originated from Arm's 2022 lawsuit against Qualcomm over alleged contract violations following Qualcomm's $1.4 billion acquisition of chip startup Nuvia. Qualcomm won a jury verdict in December 2024, which was upheld in September 2025. Arm appealed that decision.

In the current case, Qualcomm accused Arm of multiple breaches of their licensing agreement, which extends through 2033. Qualcomm alleged that Arm withheld software patches and chip-testing tools needed to verify Qualcomm's custom Oryon CPU cores. Qualcomm also claimed Arm violated a pricing structure designed to keep Qualcomm's royalties within 10% of the lowest available design pricing.

Qualcomm further alleged that Arm deliberately leaked a 2024 license-termination warning letter to Bloomberg, which Qualcomm said damaged its business reputation and cost the company approximately $170 million in a potential deal with Meta Platforms.

news.Title: Should You Buy Sandisk Stock Before Oct. 29?
news.Content:
Earnings season is getting underway, and one of the more interesting reports on the calendar belongs to Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK). Since spinning off from Western Digital in February 2025, Sandisk has emerged as a key beneficiary of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure boom.

Sandisk stock has surged as demand for memory and storage outpaces supply, creating an unusually favorable pricing environment. With fiscal first-quarter 2027 earnings scheduled for Oct. 29, Wall Street is expecting another blockbuster quarter. Investors are now wondering whether it is better to buy Sandisk stock before earnings or wait until afterward.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Wall Street has high expectations for Sandisk

Sandisk manufactures NAND flash memory, the technology powering solid-state drives (SSDs), smartphones, computers, and enterprise storage systems. As AI infrastructure expands, data centers require increasingly sophisticated storage systems to manage enormous amounts of data. That's creating an attractive value proposition for Sandisk.

For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Wall Street expects Sandisk to generate $10.7 billion in revenue alongside earnings of roughly $46 per share. These are extraordinary numbers considering the company generated $20.2 billion in revenue during its entire previous fiscal year.

What makes the upcoming report particularly interesting is that investors have already received an encouraging preview of memory industry conditions from another major manufacturer.

Micron's earnings could be a proxy for Sandisk

On Sept. 30, Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $54.2 billion, representing a jaw-dropping increase of 379% year over year. The company also reported a gross margin of 87%, underscoring the pricing power memory producers currently possess.

Management's outlook is what has me thinking Sandisk could surprise to the upside. During the earnings call, Micron's management said it expects memory and storage supply-and-demand conditions to be "much tighter" in fiscal 2027 and 2028 relative to last year.

In my eyes, this commentary suggests that both Micron and Sandisk will benefit when demand exceeds available manufacturing capacity. Sandisk's management has echoed similar thoughts around supply constraints and growing customer demand in the storage market. In turn, if NAND prices continue climbing while production remains constrained, Sandisk should be in a position to deliver stronger-than-expected revenue, profit margins, and earnings.

Story Continues

Should you buy Sandisk stock before Oct. 29?

Sandisk stock trades around $1,500, while Wall Street expects approximately $215 in earnings per share during fiscal 2027. That translates into a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 7.

On the surface, that looks inexpensive for a company experiencing explosive growth. But remember, memory manufacturers historically trade at relatively low multiples because their profits fluctuate dramatically with supply-and-demand cycles. With that said, all signs point to AI infrastructure spending being a secular tailwind. If production shortages persist through 2028, investors could begin assigning Sandisk a higher multiple.

Of course, there's no guarantee that Sandisk stock will rally following a strong earnings report. The stock could decline even after delivering impressive results if investors take profits or if management's guidance disappoints. This is why I wouldn't make Oct. 29 the deciding factor for an investment in Sandisk stock.

Instead, investors who believe in Sandisk's multiyear growth opportunity should consider dollar-cost averaging -- purchasing shares in smaller increments over a long-term time horizon rather than committing their entire allocation before one earnings announcement. While this approach doesn't eliminate downside risk, it reduces dependence on timing the perfect entry point.

Overall, I see Sandisk as an attractive semiconductor stock. Rather than trying to predict the stock's immediate reaction to the upcoming earnings report, smart investors may consider accumulating shares gradually as the more sensible long-term strategy throughout the AI infrastructure supercycle.

news.Title: Heavy Unusual Call Option Activity in Chip Designer Arm Holdings Plc - Are Investors Still Bullish?
news.Content:
A Barchart report today shows unusually heavy call option trading in Arm Holdings Plc (ARM) , an advanced semiconductor chip designer. Despite today's chip stock selloff, is this bullish, or are some stockholders selling covered calls?

ARM is up slightly today at $256.79 , despite the chip-stock turbulence. However, in the last three weeks, it has dropped from a Sept. 22 peak of $333.20. In effect, it has been flat over the last three months, as the Barchart chart below shows.

Unusual Call Options Activity in SNAP Stock - Investors Turning Bullish?

This Options Strategy Could Extract a 100% Payout from Exelon (EXC) Stock

Tired of missing midday reversals? The FREE Barchart Brief newsletter keeps you in the know. Sign up now!

This could be positioning ahead of the upcoming Nov. 4 fiscal Q2 earnings report date for the quarter ending Sept. 30. Nevertheless, analysts have significantly higher price targets (PTs) for ARM stock.

For example, Yahoo! Finance's survey of 43 analysts shows an average PT of $290.70. Similarly, Barchart's mean analyst survey PT is $292.72. These imply upside of 13.6% in ARM.

Moreover, analysts forecast 23% revenue growth this year (to the year ending March 2027) at $6.06 billion, and 36% next year ($8.25 billion). Moreover, free cash flow (FCF) soared last quarter to $705 million, representing 54.69% of revenue.

If this keeps up during Q2 and for all of this FY, FCF could reach $3.31 billion (i.e., $6.06b x 0.5469) this year and $4.51 billion next FY. That is why ARM stock does not necessarily look overvalued.

For example, using a 1.0% FCF yield metric and applying it to the next 12-month (NTM) forecast of $3.91 billion , Arm Holdings could be worth $391 billion (i.e., $3.91b / 0.01).

Even at a 1.25% FCF yield, the stock is worth $312.8 billion , or 13.84% over today's market cap of $274.78 billion.

That leads to a price target of $292.33 (i.e., 1.1384 x $256.79 price today). That's why analysts have set their PTs at this level. Howewer, next year, it could be worth even more, especially if its higher revenue estimates come into focus.

For example, FY 28 $4.51 billion FCF / 0.0125 = $360.8 billion fair value. That is 31.3% higher than today's market cap, leading to a PT of $337.17 .

That could be why some investors are willing to buy unusual volumes of out-of-the-money call options at $330, and some investors are selling at this price.

Unusual Call Options Activity in ARM

Barchart's Unusual Stock Options Activity Report today shows that almost 21,000 call options have traded at a $330 strike price for expiry on Dec. 18, 2026. That's 66 days from now and would include any upgraded price targets after the company's upcoming fiscal Q2 earnings and FCF report.

Story Continues

This volume is almost 20x the prior number of calls outstanding at that price. Moreover, the call premium is $7.46, so investors buying these calls may expect to see ARM rise to over $337.46 . (Note: this is close to our PT of $337.17 shown above).

On the other hand, it is very likely that some existing shareholders are willing to sell their shares at this strike price. They are happy to receive $7.46 in premium now for the obligation to sell at $330 in just over 2 months.

In effect, the covered call yield is high at 2.91% (i.e., $7.46/$256.79). On an annualized basis, if this can be repeated every two months, the effective yield is 17.43%, a very attractive expected return.

So, does this mean investors are still bullish on ARM? Maybe. But not necessarily. The call option seller could be doing a multi-leg trade where they are booking a call credit spread. It could also be offsetting a different leg.

But some investor, even if it is the bookmaker or brokerage firm, has to be buying these out-of-the-money calls. As I have shown, there is some basis for ARM stock to move higher and approach this call option strike price.

The bottom line is the upcoming Nov. 4 earnings release is very important. If it shows that the company's free cash flow (FCF) is staying strong and FCF margins are over 50%, ARM stock could indeed move higher.

In effect, analysts' higher PTs will be vindicated and could even rise. That would push ARM stock up.

news.Title: 3 Best AI Stocks to Buy on This Pullback (SNDK, LITE, JBL)
news.Content:
Rising risk-off sentiment is once again weighing on AI and semiconductor stocks, with some of the market's strongest performers selling off. Concerns over rapidly rising interest rates and uncertain central bank policy, compounded by geopolitical tensions and persistently strong energy prices have prompted investors to rotate into more defensive sectors.

We've seen this play out numerous times throughout the AI bull market. Periodic corrections shake out weaker hands, but the underlying growth trends continue to strengthen. And for investors willing to look beyond short-term volatility, these pullbacks have consistently presented attractive buying opportunities.

The key, in my view, is focusing on companies supplying the mission-critical infrastructure behind the AI buildout, particularly businesses benefiting from supply constraints, strong pricing power and accelerating earnings growth.

Three stocks that stand out today are Sandisk Corporation (SNDK), Lumentum (LITE) and Jabil (JBL). Each represents a different but essential piece of the AI infrastructure boom, spanning memory and storage, optical networking, and advanced electronics manufacturing.

More importantly, all three are benefiting from powerful fundamental tailwinds that appear likely to persist well beyond the current market correction.

Sandisk (SNDK): AI's Insatiable Demand for Memory and Storage

Sandisk has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI-driven memory boom. Following its separation from Western Digital, the company has become a more direct way to invest in the rapidly expanding demand for NAND flash memory and data storage.

AI systems generate and process enormous volumes of data, and that information needs to be stored, retrieved and moved efficiently. As AI workloads expand, particularly inference applications, demand for high-performance storage continues to grow.

At the same time, memory manufacturers have struggled to keep up with demand, creating one of the most significant supply-demand imbalances the industry has experienced in years. The result has been extraordinary pricing power.

Sandisk's latest quarterly results illustrate just how powerful this trend has become. Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue surged 372% year over year to nearly $9 billion, including a 51% sequential increase. Approximately two-thirds of that sequential growth came from higher pricing, with the remainder driven by increased shipment volumes.

Profitability has exploded alongside revenue. Gross margins reached 84.6%, compared with just 26.2% a year earlier, while non-GAAP earnings climbed to $39.25 per share. The company's data center business has been particularly impressive, with annual revenue surging 437% to more than $5.1 billion.

Story Continues

And according to consensus estimates, the momentum is expected to continue.

For fiscal 2027, analysts forecast revenue growth of 143% to $49.25 billion, followed by another 18.7% increase to $58.46 billion in fiscal 2028. Earnings estimates are even more impressive, with EPS expected to surge 201% this year to $213.31, before climbing another 18.5% to $252.80 next year.

These are extraordinary numbers, and even more remarkable considering the scale of the business.

Yet despite the enormous earnings growth, Sandisk currently trades at just 7x forward earnings and carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) .

Of course, that seemingly cheap valuation needs to be considered in the context of the highly cyclical memory industry. When supply is constrained and pricing is exceptionally strong, earnings can surge, making stocks appear unusually inexpensive near the peak of a cycle.

That is the primary risk here. Today's extraordinarily high margins should not be assumed to persist indefinitely, and additional supply or a slowdown in demand could eventually reverse some of the pricing gains.

However, the AI infrastructure boom has introduced a significant new source of structural demand, potentially making this cycle more durable than those of the past. If memory pricing remains elevated longer than investors anticipate, Sandisk's valuation could prove genuinely attractive.

Following its extraordinary rally over the last year, SNDK shares have spent the past six months consolidating in a wide and volatile trading range. Given the size of that range, the most attractive tactical opportunities may come either on a pullback toward support near $1,200 or on a decisive breakout above resistance around $1,800.

The former would offer a more favorable entry near support, while the latter would signal renewed bullish momentum and potentially the start of another leg higher.

Image Source: TradingView

Lumentum (LITE): The Optical Networking Bottleneck

One of the most significant challenges facing the AI infrastructure buildout is no longer simply obtaining enough computing power. Increasingly, it is figuring out how to connect all that computing power efficiently.

This is creating an enormous opportunity for Lumentum, a leading developer of advanced optical and photonic technologies.

The company manufactures high-performance lasers, optical components and networking systems that allow enormous quantities of data to move through modern data centers.

As AI clusters become larger and more sophisticated, moving information between GPUs, servers and data centers has become an increasingly difficult engineering challenge. And while adding more computing power is essential, that hardware is only as useful as the networks connecting it.

Traditional electrical connections are increasingly challenged by the bandwidth, distance and power requirements of next-generation AI systems. Optical technologies offer substantially greater bandwidth and improved power efficiency, making them a critical part of the industry's ongoing expansion.

Demand has become so intense that Lumentum recently indicated that some of its AI-related optical components are effectively sold out through early 2029.

That is an extraordinary level of demand visibility, particularly for a hardware supplier, and suggests the industry's capacity constraints are unlikely to disappear overnight.

The financial implications are becoming increasingly apparent.

Lumentum's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue more than doubled year over year to approximately $1.01 billion, while non-GAAP earnings surged to $3.23 per share from $0.88 in the year-ago quarter. Operating margins have also expanded dramatically, reaching 36.6% from just 15% a year earlier.

And based on current analyst forecasts, the company is only getting started.

According to Zacks consensus estimates, fiscal 2027 revenue is projected to more than double, rising 107% to $6.25 billion. Analysts then expect another 60.5% increase in fiscal 2028, bringing annual sales above $10 billion.

Earnings growth should be even more explosive. EPS is expected to surge 146.8% to $21.40 this fiscal year, followed by another 64% increase to $35.08 next year.

These forecasts represent one of the more aggressive growth trajectories anywhere in the AI infrastructure industry.

That growth comes at a price, however. Lumentum currently trades at approximately 46.4x forward earnings , a considerable premium even among rapidly growing technology companies.

While the valuation is elevated, it is not necessarily unreasonable given the company's extraordinary earnings outlook and unusually strong demand visibility.

Beyond its existing products, Lumentum is positioned to benefit from emerging technologies including optical circuit switching, 1.6-terabit networking modules and co-packaged optics. These technologies should become increasingly important as hyperscalers build larger AI clusters while attempting to contain networking costs and power consumption.

The main risk is that expectations have become exceptionally high. Any disappointment in orders, capacity expansion or margins could trigger substantial volatility, particularly following the stock's enormous rally.

Nevertheless, with its products occupying an increasingly critical position in AI infrastructure and demand expected to substantially exceed available supply, Lumentum remains one of the most compelling growth stories in the sector.

After breaking out from a significant consolidation earlier this month, LITE shares have pulled back to retest the breakout level.

This is a critical area to watch. Ideally, the stock should find support here and resume its uptrend, confirming the breakout. A failure to hold this level, however, could open the door to further downside and potentially serve as an early warning sign for the broader AI infrastructure trade.

Jabil (JBL): My Favorite AI Stock on This Pullback

Of the three stocks discussed today, Jabil may offer the most compelling combination of growth, valuation and technical positioning.

Unlike Sandisk and Lumentum, which operate in highly specialized areas of memory and optical networking, Jabil provides advanced manufacturing, engineering and supply chain services to some of the world's largest technology companies.

Its capabilities span data center hardware, server infrastructure, networking equipment, power systems and other sophisticated electronics.

Building AI infrastructure at scale involves far more than purchasing GPUs. Companies need complex server assemblies, networking systems, power distribution equipment, cooling infrastructure and an enormous network of components and suppliers.

Jabil helps customers manage this complexity, allowing them to ramp production and deploy infrastructure more efficiently.

And as hyperscalers continue committing hundreds of billions of dollars to AI infrastructure, Jabil is capturing a rapidly growing share of that spending.

In fiscal 2026, revenue increased 21% to $36 billion, while core operating margins expanded by 40 basis points. The company also generated more than $1.5 billion in adjusted free cash flow.

More importantly, management expects the growth to accelerate considerably in fiscal 2027.

The company recently guided for approximately $44.5 billion in revenue this year, representing 24% growth, while core earnings are expected to rise 34% to $17.55 per share.

AI-related revenue alone is expected to surge 54% to approximately $22.1 billion, approaching half of total sales.

That is a remarkable transformation for a company that has historically operated in the relatively mature electronics manufacturing industry.

And the consensus outlook suggests the momentum should continue well beyond the current year.

Analysts expect fiscal 2027 revenue of $44.62 billion, followed by another 15.3% increase to $51.45 billion in fiscal 2028. Earnings are expected to grow 34.5% to $17.61 per share this year, then another 25% to $22.02 next year.

What's particularly attractive is that investors aren't being asked to pay an excessive premium for that growth.

Jabil currently trades at just 17.7x forward earnings and carries a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) , highlighting the strength of its earnings outlook and estimate revision trends.

For a company expected to grow earnings more than 34% this year and another 25% next year, that valuation looks especially reasonable.

Jabil also offers some diversification beyond AI infrastructure, with exposure to healthcare, automotive, industrial and other end markets. While AI has become an increasingly important growth driver, the company is not entirely dependent on a single industry.

There are risks, of course. Electronics manufacturing is a relatively low-margin business, and even modest disruptions to customer spending or manufacturing efficiency can have an outsized impact on profitability.

However, the combination of accelerating revenue growth, improving margins and substantial free cash flow generation puts Jabil in a particularly attractive position.

Along with the broader AI trade, JBL shares began correcting over the summer. Since then, the stock has carved out a compelling bullish wedge pattern, with support near $285 and resistance around $320.

A decisive breakout in either direction would provide an important signal, with a move above resistance suggesting the uptrend is ready to resume, while a breakdown below support could open the door to further downside.

Of the three stocks highlighted today, I think Jabil has the cleanest technical setup. Combined with its Zacks Rank #1, impressive growth forecasts and comparatively modest valuation, it stands out as my favorite opportunity on the current pullback.

AI Infrastructure Still Offers Compelling Opportunities

The recent selling pressure across AI-related stocks is understandably frustrating, particularly after the enormous gains many of these companies have delivered.

But investors should distinguish between deteriorating business fundamentals and a correction driven by changing sentiment, crowded positioning or valuation concerns.

For now, the fundamental picture across the most critical areas of AI infrastructure remains exceptionally strong.

Importantly, these companies are not merely trading on distant expectations of AI adoption. Their revenue, earnings and forward guidance already reflect significant real-world demand.

That doesn't mean the stocks cannot fall further. Valuations remain elevated in parts of the sector, and a meaningful slowdown in hyperscaler capital expenditures would present a serious risk to the broader investment thesis.

But until there is convincing evidence of a sustained deterioration in AI infrastructure spending or earnings expectations, I continue to view these corrections as opportunities rather than a reason to abandon the theme.

For investors looking to take advantage of the current weakness, Sandisk, Lumentum and Jabil represent three compelling ways to gain exposure to some of the most important and supply-constrained segments of the AI infrastructure boom.

news.Title: Why Sandisk Stock Dropped Again on Tuesday
news.Content:
Uh-oh. It's starting again. Competition from China on computer memory sales is roiling stock markets, and once again, Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) stock looks caught in the turmoil.

Last time this happened, in July, it cost Sandisk stock a near-50% decline in a month . Should investors expect a repeat of July's troubles?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Well, Sandisk stock shed 6% on Monday, and as markets reopen Tuesday, Sandisk stock is falling another 3.5% as of 11 a.m. ET.

Image source: The Motley Fool.

CXMT in the news

Blame Chinese DRAM company ChangXin Memory Technologies, CXMT. CXMT went public in July with a $487 billion market capitalization and a promise to expand DRAM production and steal market share from Western computer memory makers . In a supply-constrained market, even Apple was looking to buy memory chips from CXMT!

That plan fell apart after Apple discovered CXMT wanted it to pay the same (or worse) prices for DRAM as SK Hynix and Samsung were charging. And seeing as CXMT's chips were "two or three generations" behind current DRAM technology, Apple declined.

But now, CXMT is making a move to improve its technology. The company's new "4F square" stacked DRAM architecture promises to increase the storage density of its chips and make the product more competitive with Micron's, SK's, and Samsung's wares. CXMT hopes to use the new technology to begin producing high-bandwidth memory (HBM) later this year.

Should Sandisk investors worry?

Memory supply remains in deficit and may get even tighter next year. So long as CXMT's chips primarily supply the low end of the mobile phone market, rather than AI data centers, Sandisk's high-margin AI sales should be safe. Moreover, CXMT isn't (yet) producing NAND chips, which are Sandisk's specialty.

Although both companies target HBM, they're approaching from different directions. I see greater risk to Micron stock than to Sandisk.

news.Title: These 3 Chip Stocks Could Strike Gold in AI's $150 Billion Boom
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

AI's next memory race could create a new divide among chipmakers, with Goldman Sachs seeing SanDisk ( NASDAQ:SNDK ), SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics as better positioned than Micron Technology to capitalize on a developing storage technology.

The opportunity centers on high-bandwidth flash (HBF), which could help AI systems process requests more economically by making better use of expensive computing hardware. Goldman analyst James Schneider estimates the market could reach $40 billion to $150 billion by 2030, depending on how quickly chip designers adopt the technology.

Goldman favors SanDisk ( NASDAQ:SNDK ) and SK Hynix for their HBF capabilities, while Samsung Electronics receives a Buy rating based on its NAND flash business. news.Title: Should You Buy, Sell, or Hold Cisco Stock After a 68% Rise in a Year?
news.Content:
Cisco Systems CSCO shares have surged 68% over the past year, outperforming the broader Zacks Computer & Technology sector, which rose 27.9%.

The company's shares have also outperformed peers, including Arista Networks ANET and Broadcom AVGO. Both Arista Networks and Broadcom are expanding their footprints in the data center infrastructure and artificial intelligence (AI) networking space. Shares of Arista Networks and Broadcom have rallied 52% and 3.1%, respectively, over the past year.

The outperformance can be attributed to the accelerating AI infrastructure investments, strong hyperscaler demand and a multiyear networking upgrade cycle. The growing adoption of Silicon One platforms, optical networking solutions and campus networking products, alongside strengthening demand for cybersecurity, Splunk and observability solutions, is driving growth.

CSCO Stock Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

CSCO Benefits From AI Push & Strong Networking Growth

Cisco is benefiting from accelerating AI infrastructure investments, strong networking demand and an expanding portfolio of security and observability solutions. The growing adoption of agentic AI is driving demand for high-bandwidth, low-latency networking infrastructure across hyperscale data centers, enterprises and cloud environments, strengthening Cisco's growth prospects.

Cisco's AI infrastructure business continues to gain momentum. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the company secured $4 billion in hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders, bringing fiscal 2026 orders to $9.3 billion, approximately 4.5 times the previous year's level. The company's Silicon One architecture, particularly its P200 and G200-powered systems and Acacia optical solutions, is strengthening its competitive position. Cisco expects hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenues to reach $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027 compared with approximately $4 billion in fiscal 2026.

Strong networking demand has been noteworthy. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, networking revenues surged 28% year over year, supported by triple-digit growth in AI infrastructure and double-digit growth in data center switching. Networking product orders increased 40%, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Data center networking orders grew more than 35%, while campus networking orders increased 20%, reflecting strong demand for infrastructure upgrades.

CSCO Benefits From Expanding Security Portfolio

Cisco Systems is benefiting from its expanding security portfolio, growing adoption of AI-driven cybersecurity solutions and strengthening Splunk momentum. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Security revenues increased 14% year over year to $2.23 billion. The entire security portfolio, including Splunk, recorded double-digit order growth.

More than 1,500 customers purchased Secure Access, XDR, Hypershield and AI Defense, bringing total net new customers to more than 6,400 since launch. Firewall orders increased more than 30%. The company expects security and observability growth to improve to high single digits in fiscal 2027.

Further expanding its portfolio, in August 2026, Cisco expanded its Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA NVDA through a partnership with Supermicro, strengthening its AI infrastructure portfolio with rack-scale computing solutions.

The expanded offering integrates Supermicro's liquid- and air-cooled servers with Cisco's AI networking systems, enabling enterprises, neoclouds and sovereign clouds to efficiently manage large-scale AI workloads. Supporting NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and HGX Rubin NVL8 platforms, the architecture facilitates trillion-parameter model training and high-throughput inference. Cisco's NVIDIA Cloud Partner-compliant architecture aims to simplify AI deployment, enhance security, and accelerate infrastructure scalability.

Story Continues

CSCO Initiates Positive Q1 2027 Guidance

Cisco's outlook for the fiscal first quarter of 2027 remains strong, driven by strong AI demand, accelerating networking investments and improving security momentum.

For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Cisco expects revenues between $18 billion and $18.2 billion. Non-GAAP earnings are projected to be in the range of $1.32-$1.34 per share.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for Cisco's first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenues is pegged at $18.09 billion, suggesting growth of 21.54% year over year.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for first-quarter fiscal 2027 earnings is pegged at $1.33 per share, up by a penny over the past 30 days and indicating 33% growth over the year-ago quarter's reported figure.

news.Title: Can Nokia's Multi-PON Line Card Meet Growing AI Connectivity Demands?
news.Content:
Nokia Corporation NOK has introduced a new 50G/25G/10G/GPON (Gigabit Passive Optical Network) line card to help telecom operators upgrade their fiber broadband networks with greater flexibility and lower investment risk. The innovation aims to prepare network infrastructure for the growing demands of artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing and high-speed connectivity.

Built on Nokia's Quillion chipset, the 16-port line card supports GPON, 10G, 25G and 50G PON technologies on every port, enabling fiber access speeds of up to 50Gbps. This allows operators to upgrade network speeds as demand grows without replacing existing infrastructure. Operators can also add higher-speed technologies when needed, helping them manage investments efficiently and create new revenue opportunities.

The company's new platform offers up to four times lower upstream latency, enabling faster data transmission and improving performance for data-intensive applications. It also includes quantum-safe encryption and authentication to protect network and user data from emerging threats, while enhanced resilience helps ensure reliable connectivity for critical services.

With general availability planned for 2027, the launch strengthens Nokia's position in fiber broadband infrastructure. The solution gives telecom operators greater flexibility to expand network capacity and meet the growing connectivity needs of AI-driven applications.

How Are Competitors Performing?

Nokia faces stiff competition from Ericsson ERIC and Cisco Systems, Inc. CSCO. Ericsson is improving network performance through AI-powered 5G technology to increase data speeds, coverage and efficiency. The company is working with telecom operators to improve network capacity and reliability. Ericsson is advancing next-generation wireless technology to support automated network management and new digital services.

Cisco is developing advanced networking chips to handle growing AI workloads and improve data center performance. The company is using AI-powered tools to help businesses detect network issues and automate troubleshooting. Cisco is enhancing network management and traffic visibility to help organizations monitor performance and resolve connectivity problems more efficiently.

NOK's Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates

Nokia shares have soared 81% over the past year against the industry's decline of 0.7%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

From a valuation standpoint, Nokia trades at a forward price-to-sales ratio of 2.25, below the industry tally of 4.67.

Story Continues

news.Title: Analyst lists 7 reasons why China CXMT’s claims don’t threaten Micron and Sandisk
news.Content:
Investing.com -- China's CXMT is claiming it will introduce a DDR5 RDIMM using a one-third smaller 4F-squared cell design by year-end, but Mizuho TMT specialist Jordan Klein says the announcement changes nothing for investors in Micron, SanDisk, SK Hynix, or Samsung Electronics.

Before you buy NVIDIA: our AI model's stock picks are beating the market by 120%+. See the list now »

"I would not be selling or in a panic if I owned MU, SNDK, SKHY or Samsung over comments yesterday by CXMT sr mgmt. about their new advanced DDR5 design roadmap. To me this changed nothing near term. Something to watch and monitor closely, but that is about it," Klein wrote in a note to clients.

The CXMT roadmap centers on a DDR5 RDIMM that uses a 4F-squared cell architecture combined with a vertical surrounding gate transistor, targeted for product introduction by the end of 2026.

The proposed cell would be roughly one-third smaller than the 6F-squared geometry used in current DDR5 designs, according to Mizuho's summary of CXMT's claims.

Klein laid out seven reasons why the announcement falls well short of a competitive threat. The most pointed is a timeline mismatch: Samsung's reported mass-production target for comparable 4F-squared DRAM technology is 2028, versus CXMT's stated end-of-2026 product introduction.

Klein argues those milestones cannot be compared directly. "A year-end product introduction can't be directly compared with Samsung's reported 2028 mass-production target. A launch doesn't establish manufacturing maturity, yields, or cost competitiveness," he wrote.

On the supply-glut concern that rattled some memory investors, Klein is equally skeptical. "CXMT hasn't shown mass-production success or verified yields and performance for its 4F² products, so it's premature to assume an imminent supply glut," he noted.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

CXMT has not released complete specifications, verified yields, customer qualification results, or commercial-scale shipment commitments for the 4F-squared server RDIMM.

Klein also pushed back on the assumption that a smaller cell size automatically translates to lower chip cost, noting that process complexity, yields, and integration all factor into the final cost equation — areas where CXMT has yet to demonstrate competitive parity.

He further stressed that the product in question is conventional server DRAM, not High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), the stacked memory architecture central to AI accelerator racks built around GPUs and ASICs.

Story Continues

That distinction limits CXMT's near-term relevance to the AI compute buildout that has driven the premium valuations for leading memory suppliers.

Notably, CXMT's 4F-squared ambitions are not unique to China. Mizuho points out that both Samsung and SK Hynix are pursuing similar DDR5 4F-squared designs, meaning the technology itself is an industry-wide transition rather than a Chinese breakthrough.

A Digitimes report that Klein described as "more balanced" reportedly poured cold water on CXMT's advancement claims as well, lending additional weight to his skeptical read.

Still, Klein is careful not to wave off the longer-term competitive picture entirely. "You do not want to dismiss CXMT or their NAND peer YMTC. And I am not doing that," he wrote and added that CXMT is investing aggressively to supply domestic Chinese customers with both conventional DRAM and more advanced memory.

news.Title: Here's Why Investors Should Hold ACN Stock in Their Portfolios Now
news.Content:
Accenture 's ACN growth is driven by rising enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, demand for digital transformation and targeted acquisitions. Its expanding AI capabilities and diversified service portfolio support deeper client engagement and long-term organic growth. Operating efficiencies support margin expansion, while strong cash flow funds investments and shareholder returns.

The company's fiscal 2027 and 2028 earnings are expected to increase 5.1% and 8.2% year over year, respectively. Its revenues are projected to grow 4.2% in fiscal 2027 and 4.7% in fiscal 2028.

Factors That Bode Well for ACN's Success

AI-Led Transformation Drives Growth: Rising enterprise AI adoption is fueling demand for Accenture's digital transformation and data modernization services. In fiscal 2026, more than 400 clients initiated their first advanced AI engagements. Revenues from its eight emerging AI and data partners more than doubled, while bookings more than tripled year over year. For fiscal 2027, management expects inorganic revenues to contribute 2% to 2.5% and plans about $5 billion in additional acquisitions. These investments should broaden Accenture's service offerings, deepen industry expertise and support higher organic growth over time.

Operating Efficiency & Cash Generation Support Returns: Accenture's focus on operating efficiency and contract profitability continues to support earnings growth and shareholder returns. In fiscal 2026, adjusted operating margin expanded 20 basis points to 15.8%, while adjusted EPS rose 8% to $13.97. Free cash flow increased 7% to $11.6 billion, supporting record shareholder returns of $11.5 billion. For fiscal 2027, management expects an operating margin of 15.9-16.1%, EPS of $14.39-$14.81 and free cash flow of $11-$11.8 billion. The region represents approximately $1 billion in annualized revenues, with fiscal 2027 guidance assuming no growth at the upper end and potential deterioration at the lower end. Management expects local-currency revenue growth of 3-6% in fiscal 2027. Persistent spending weakness and regional disruptions could constrain organic growth and delay demand recovery.

Pricing Competition & AI Efficiencies Weigh on Margins: Accenture faces pricing pressure as competition intensifies and AI-driven efficiencies reshape service delivery. Despite stable overall pricing in fiscal 2026, management reported lower pricing across several areas in the fourth quarter. AI-led productivity gains also require greater client value at potentially lower costs. Fiscal 2027 operating margin guidance of 15.9-16.1% reflects continued competition. Persistent pricing pressure and AI-driven efficiencies could limit margin expansion unless offset by higher business volumes and expanded service offerings.

news.Title: Micron's HBM4 Ramp-Up: Can Higher Pricing Lift Margins Further?
news.Content:
Micron Technology, Inc. MU is positioned to benefit from the rising demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) as AI companies build more powerful data centers. Its HBM4 ramp-up could support further margin growth if strong demand, higher prices and efficient production continue.

Micron's fourth-quarter 2026 revenues jumped 379.3% year over year to $54.23 billion, while the full fiscal 2026 top line surged 256.3% to $133.19 billion. The fourth-quarter non-GAAP gross margin reached 87%, up from 45.7% in the year-ago quarter. The company's full fiscal 2026 gross margin reached 81.1% from 41.1% in fiscal 2025, highlighting the benefits of favorable memory pricing and strong demand.

HBM is an important part of this opportunity. Micron reported that HBM revenues grew faster than total company revenues in the fourth quarter. It has also completed agreements covering most of its HBM bit supply for calendar year 2027, with significantly higher prices than the previous year. These agreements offer better revenue visibility and could help support profitability as shipments increase.

Micron's HBM4 progress adds another growth opportunity. The company said its 12-high HBM4 production ramp-up is advancing twice as fast as the comparable HBM3E generation, and it has already shipped more than $1 billion in HBM4 revenues. Faster production growth and better manufacturing yields could help reduce costs and improve returns as volumes rise.

Pricing is another potential margin driver. Micron has secured most of its 2027 HBM supply agreements at significantly higher year-over-year prices. Management expects these prices to narrow the gross-margin gap between HBM and conventional DRAM. However, the actual benefit will depend on production costs, product yields and how quickly shipments increase.

Micron's HBM4 ramp-up and higher contract prices provide a strong foundation for further margin improvement. Its 87% fourth-quarter gross margin already reflects favorable market conditions, but sustaining such high levels will depend on execution and continued AI spending. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Micron expects non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 86.25%.

How Do Rivals Fare Against Micron in AI Memory Space?

Micron's major competitors, SK hynix SKHY and Sandisk Corporation SNDK, are also benefiting from AI-led demand for memory and storage solutions.

SK hynix is one of Micron's closest DRAM rivals and has a strong position in HBM, which is critical for AI accelerators. In the second quarter of 2026, SK hynix generated 79.3 trillion Korean won in revenues, up 257% year over year, while operating profit surged 557% to 60.5 trillion won. HBM, AI-server DRAM and enterprise SSDs drove the strong results.

Story Continues

Sandisk is more focused on NAND and storage than DRAM, but it is another stock that stands to benefit from AI infrastructure spending. Its fiscal 2026 revenues jumped 175% to $20.25 billion, while data-center revenues soared 437% to $5.15 billion. Sandisk's fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenues also surged 372% sequentially to $8.97 billion, showing strong demand for storage products used in data centers.

Both companies highlight the broadening AI-driven demand for memory and storage, although Micron remains particularly well-positioned in DRAM and HBM.

news.Title: Cisco Systems, Inc. (CSCO) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It
news.Content:
Cisco Systems (CSCO) has recently been on Zacks.com's list of the most searched stocks. Therefore, you might want to consider some of the key factors that could influence the stock's performance in the near future.

Shares of this seller of routers, switches, software and services have returned +4.8% over the past month versus the Zacks S&P 500 composite's +2.1% change. The Zacks Computer - Networking industry, to which Cisco belongs, has gained 2.8% over this period. Now the key question is: Where could the stock be headed in the near term?

Although media reports or rumors about a significant change in a company's business prospects usually cause its stock to trend and lead to an immediate price change, there are always certain fundamental factors that ultimately drive the buy-and-hold decision.

Earnings Estimate Revisions

Here at Zacks, we prioritize appraising the change in the projection of a company's future earnings over anything else. That's because we believe the present value of its future stream of earnings is what determines the fair value for its stock.

We essentially look at how sell-side analysts covering the stock are revising their earnings estimates to reflect the impact of the latest business trends. And if earnings estimates go up for a company, the fair value for its stock goes up. A higher fair value than the current market price drives investors' interest in buying the stock, leading to its price moving higher. This is why empirical research shows a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and near-term stock price movements.

Cisco is expected to post earnings of $1.33 per share for the current quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +33%. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus Estimate has changed +0.8%.

The consensus earnings estimate of $5.11 for the current fiscal year indicates a year-over-year change of +18%. This estimate has changed +0.1% over the last 30 days.

For the next fiscal year, the consensus earnings estimate of $5.59 indicates a change of +9.4% from what Cisco is expected to report a year ago. Over the past month, the estimate has changed +0.2%.

With an impressive externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool -- the Zacks Rank -- is a more conclusive indicator of a stock's near-term price performance, as it effectively harnesses the power of earnings estimate revisions. The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) for Cisco.

Story Continues

The chart below shows the evolution of the company's forward 12-month consensus EPS estimate:

12 Month EPS

Revenue Growth Forecast

While earnings growth is arguably the most superior indicator of a company's financial health, nothing happens as such if a business isn't able to grow its revenues. After all, it's nearly impossible for a company to increase its earnings for an extended period without increasing its revenues. So, it's important to know a company's potential revenue growth.

In the case of Cisco, the consensus sales estimate of $18.09 billion for the current quarter points to a year-over-year change of +21.5%. The $73.03 billion and $77.87 billion estimates for the current and next fiscal years indicate changes of +15.3% and +6.6%, respectively.

Last Reported Results and Surprise History

Cisco reported revenues of $17.25 billion in the last reported quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +17.6%. EPS of $1.22 for the same period compares with $0.99 a year ago.

Compared to the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $16.85 billion, the reported revenues represent a surprise of +2.36%. The EPS surprise was +4.27%.

The company beat consensus EPS estimates in each of the trailing four quarters. The company topped consensus revenue estimates each time over this period.

Valuation

No investment decision can be efficient without considering a stock's valuation. Whether a stock's current price rightly reflects the intrinsic value of the underlying business and the company's growth prospects is an essential determinant of its future price performance.

Comparing the current value of a company's valuation multiples, such as its price-to-earnings (P/E), price-to-sales (P/S), and price-to-cash flow (P/CF), to its own historical values helps ascertain whether its stock is fairly valued, overvalued, or undervalued, whereas comparing the company relative to its peers on these parameters gives a good sense of how reasonable its stock price is.

The Zacks Value Style Score (part of the Zacks Style Scores system), which pays close attention to both traditional and unconventional valuation metrics to grade stocks from A to F (an A is better than a B; a B is better than a C; and so on), is pretty helpful in identifying whether a stock is overvalued, rightly valued, or temporarily undervalued.

Cisco is graded F on this front, indicating that it is trading at a premium to its peers. Click here to see the values of some of the valuation metrics that have driven this grade.

Conclusion

The facts discussed here and much other information on Zacks.com might help determine whether or not it's worthwhile paying attention to the market buzz about Cisco. However, its Zacks Rank #2 does suggest that it may outperform the broader market in the near term.

台股今（13）日賣壓沉重，指數盤中大跌超過1200點，跌破4萬9千點大關，電子族群普遍走弱，DRAM、矽光子更是淪為重災區，拖累大盤終場下跌960點，收在48341點，成交量約1.19兆元。儘管證交所出面喊話，資本市場有一定支撐，會密切關注政經情勢變化，不過投資人信心還是沒有回籠，從籌碼面來看，三大法人周二合計賣超台股1984億元，其中，外資大砍1653億，創史上第三大賣超紀錄，也讓新台幣兌美元在盤中跟著貶值超過3角，雖然央行尾盤調節之下收32.085元，但仍重貶1.9角，還爆出史上第二大成交量，合計台北與元太外匯經紀公司達54.33億美元。

台股盤面一片綠油油，因為美股重挫、日韓股13日也開低，拖累台股跟著大跳水，指數盤中重挫超過1200點，跌破4萬9千點整數大關，而且不只大型權值股遭到拋售，中小型股也難敵賣壓，櫃買指數同樣走跌。

群益期貨分析師 徐楨榕：「費半在獲利最好跟成長性最好的板塊遭受獲利了結，多少會影響到台股的情緒，記憶體板塊，特別是韓股的部分今天是重挫，當然會連帶影響到近日的台股，多少是用融資攻起來的，通常整數的關卡其實都會稍微回測到將近3%的附近，可能大概會落在4萬8到4萬8500。」

觀察盤面類股表現，台積電力守2500元，台達電跌約半根停板，DRAM概念股雖然財報表現亮眼卻利多不漲，南亞科、華邦電紛紛重挫，光通訊聯亞、光聖也同步回檔，只剩金融、塑化等非電族群逆勢抗跌。

就怕台股急挫引發投資人恐慌，證交所也趕緊出面喊話，表示台股因為跟國際市場連動高，現在受到多重因素影響短期波動，股價出現變化，不過台股資本市場還是有一定支撐，證交所將會密切關注相關情形。專家也表示，在短線反應過後，接下來仍持續看好企業獲利動能。

華南投顧董事長 呂仁傑：「往明年看我們認為在台股這邊來看，台股企業獲利的狀況今年往明年看，應該還有2到3成左右的增長幅度，市場應該在經歷10月這邊的修正之後，往11月來看整個行情應該還是向上的，我們看今年第四季就有機會挑戰5萬3千點。」

除了內資有信心外資同樣很樂觀，高盛最新報告再喊加碼，還給出法人圈最高目標價，預估台股未來12個月有望衝上57500點，所以在國際利空變數淡化，大盤還是有機會重返基本面主導格局。（記者謝旻蓁、林家弘／台北採訪報導）

中國A股今(13)日早盤偏弱，午後跌勢明顯收斂，整體情緒較前段時間回穩。上證指數重返3800點關卡、收於3,800.86點，上漲3.62點或0.10%，日K翻紅；深證成指收於12,353.70點，下跌31.17點或0.25%；創業板指收於2,958.34點，下跌5.48點或0.18%；科創50指數收於1,427.18點，小漲0.03%。
