news.Title: Elon Musk explains why chip stocks are getting drilled on news out of China
news.Content:
Hot chip stocks like Micron ( MU ) and Sandisk ( SNDK ) are taking it on the chin out of the gate this week.

Ask the world's richest person, Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and he will probably say the sell-off is just beginning.

"When China figures out how to manufacture a product, their ability to scale is often greater than the rest of the world combined. We saw this with lithium batteries and solar, for example," Musk said in a new post on X .

Musk was replying to a post about the fresh chip stock sell-off, which is being fueled by Chinese tech player CXMT . The company's president, Cao Kanyu, called out "key progress" on a new cell architecture at an event in Shanghai over the weekend.

CXMT plans to roll out new memory products based on the architecture by the end of the year.

The development sparked concern that growing Chinese competition could threaten memory chip pricing power, causing investors to unwind crowded momentum AI trades.

Micron shed 3.8% in Monday's trading session and is down another 4% in premarket trading today. Sandisk lost 5.9% on Monday and is off by 5% today.

Sharp sell-offs are also being seen in other memory names, including SK Hynix ( SKHY ), Western Digital ( WDC ), and Seagate ( STX ).

Added Musk, "SpaceX is a rare counter-example, where its mass to orbit is roughly an order of magnitude greater than the rest of the world, BUT China now does the majority of non-SpaceX mass to orbit. SpaceX is an anomaly in the matrix. Maybe RAM will be different, but RAM was a low margin commodity only ~3 years ago. LP5 and LP6 are designed to a common standard that China seems to be solving fast."

news.Title: 晶片股拋售潮席捲亞洲 韓股暴跌觸發暫停交易 亞股周二全線收低
news.Content:
亞太股市周二(13日)劇烈震盪，MSCI亞太(日本除外)指數大跌逾2%，摔至今年7月下旬以來新低。隨前一晚美國費城半導體指數(SOX-US)下跌2.7%，市場對人工智慧(AI)供應鏈龐大資本支出的獲利能力產生疑慮，引發全球晶片與科技股大規模拋售潮，重創亞洲主要股市。

在消息面上，市場傳出中國記憶體大廠長鑫存儲(CXMT)在DRAM架構取得突破，晶胞面積縮減約30%並計畫於2026年底推出新產品。這引發投資人擔憂中國業者加速縮小技術差距，未來記憶體市場恐面臨競爭加劇與過剩風險，直接衝擊美韓晶片巨頭的溢價優勢。

同時，市場開始檢視AI企業的資本投入報酬率與實際獲利能力。加上美國10年期公債殖利率仍在高點5.2%附近、布蘭特原油價格維持在每桶106美元高檔以及美元走強，高利率環境使資金成本顯著上升，壓抑風險資產評價。

南韓(KOSPI指數)成為周二受創最深的主力市場，指數盤中重挫逾7%，一度跌破6,000點大關，終場大跌5.46%，收6,035.35點。由於波動過於劇烈，南韓交易所一度啟動5分鐘的單側熔斷(Sidecar)機制，為近兩個月來首次。市值占比極高的記憶體雙雄三星電子與SK海力士分別重挫7.4%與10%，均為連續第5個交易日下跌。

日本日經指數下挫近2%。其中記憶體大廠鎧俠(Kioxia)暴跌逾13%，科技投資巨頭軟銀(SoftBank)重挫超8%。亞洲晶片股賣壓同步遞延至歐美市場，那斯達克期貨跌幅在0.6%至1%之間，歐洲股市期貨下滑0.2%至0.4%。

分析師指出，半導體產業仍具周期性特徵，後續市場焦點將轉向即將公布的美國大型銀行財報、美國CPI通膨數據，以及ASML與台積電等半導體龍頭的最新法說會展望，藉此評估AI資本支出動能與全球資金走向。

news.Title: Global chip selloff deepens as AI worries, China competition weigh
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Shares of U.S. and European chipmakers fell Tuesday as a selloff in AI-exposed stocks deepened, pulling the broader technology sector lower amid concerns over the sustainability of AI investment and intensifying competition.

European chip names were hit harder. STMicroelectronics dipped 2.6%, Soitec and Infineon fell more than 1%, while chip-testing company Technoprobe slid 2.6%. Siltronic slipped 1.4%, Aixtron fell 1.9%, and ASM International lost 2.4%. Among equipment makers, ASML and BE Semiconductor shed over 1% each.

The moves followed a steep drop in Asian memory stocks. SK Hynix plunged 10%, Samsung Electronics lost 7.4%, and Tokyo-listed Kioxia fell as much as 13.3%. In Japan, SoftBank Group, which has significant exposure to the global AI industry, sank 8.5% and led a broader retreat in the country's semiconductor and electronics shares.

Those declines came after a weak session for tech on Wall Street, where the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.44% Monday. Micron slid 3.9% as investors weighed rising competition from China's ChangXin Memory Technologies. Over the weekend, CXMT said it had made significant progress on a new chip architecture designed to increase memory density by packing more data into a smaller space.

news.Title: 《韓股》半導體賣壓拖累 KOSPI收跌5.46%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-13 16:43:12 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(13)日明顯轉弱，韓國KOSPI指數收於6035.35點，下跌348.89點或5.46%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於837.03點，下跌12.16點或1.43%。盤中賣壓一度使KOSPI指數跌至6000點下方，尾盤雖勉強收復整數關卡，但整體基調仍是急跌與避險升溫。

外部環境方面，市場壓力主要來自風險趨避情緒升高，外資賣超成為壓低指數的主要力量，韓元兌美元同步走弱，也放大了資金撤離的氣氛。盤中波動急劇放大，KOSPI指數早盤還觸發「sell sidecar」，顯示市場對下行風險已明顯敏感。

半導體權值股方面，跌勢最重的是晶片族群，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)與SK hynix(000660.KS)走弱，成為KOSPI指數回檔的主要拖累。市場解讀，長鑫存儲(CXMT)傳出DRAM技術進展並擬推出新產品後，韓國記憶體股承受直接壓力，AI估值疑慮與中國晶片競爭升溫也進一步打擊信心。

類股與個股方面，在權值股領跌下，KOSPI指數相關大型科技股同步承壓，KOSDAQ指數雖然跌幅較小，但也無法獨善其身。市場沒有出現明顯的防禦性轉強，顯示賣壓並非只集中在單一個股，而是延伸到整體科技資產與高估值族群。

news.Title: 《日股》AI賣壓拖累 日經收跌1.82%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-13 16:33:28 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(13)日走勢分歧，日經225指數收於67,777.52點，下跌1,253.40點或1.82%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於4,110.67點，上漲5.86點或0.14%。市場主軸仍是AI與半導體相關股遭到拋售，日經指數盤中跌幅一度逼近2,000點，尾盤雖略有收斂，但仍明顯承壓，顯示權值科技股的走弱是今日盤面核心。

科技權值股方面，前一交易日美國半導體股走弱，壓力迅速傳導至日股。東京威力科創(8035.JP)、愛德萬測試(6857.JP)、軟銀集團(9984.JP)、Kioxia Holdings(285A.JP)、Lasertec(6920.JP)、TDK(6762.JP)、Murata Manufacturing(6981.JP)等個股多數下跌，成為日經指數回檔主因；相較之下，Fast Retailing(9983.JP)、Recruit Holdings(6098.JP)、FANUC(6954.JP)等則走強，對大盤跌勢提供一定緩衝。

類股方面，盤面資金並未全面撤離，而是明顯轉向海運、石油與煤炭製品、銀行與保險等類股，商船三井(9104.JP)等航運股表現突出；相較之下，非鐵金屬、電機設備、資訊與通信等類股偏弱，顯示市場在AI與半導體估值回檔之際，資金改抱較具防禦與循環特性的族群。

外部變數方面，中東情勢不明與原油價格偏強，讓能源成本與通膨壓力的疑慮升高，進一步壓抑風險偏好。市場也關注AI大型投資能否轉化為實際獲利，以及半導體需求是否持續，這些因素持續左右資金對高估值成長股的態度。

news.Title: 台股收跌960點！ 金融、台塑四寶逆勢揚 「這檔千金」創新高
news.Content:
受美國費城半導體指數連四挫及科技股賣壓籠罩影響，台股今（13）日多頭重挫。加權指數開低走低，盤中一度大跌逾1,200點、失守49,000點大關，終場重挫960.65點，收在48,341.31點，跌幅1.95%，回測月線尋求支撐，成交量1.12兆元。

電子權值股成為今日賣壓重災區，台積電（2330）因法說會前夕遭遇外資提款，重挫50元至2490元，跌幅1.97%，聯發科（2454）、台達電（2308）等權值大將也連袂壓低，聯發科下跌100元，來到4525元，跌幅2.16%，台達電下跌125元，來到1775元跌幅6.58%。鴻海下跌4.50元，來到240.00元，跌幅1.84%。

然而，盤面資金迅速轉向避險與傳產族群，台塑四寶營運回溫展現抗跌韌性，台塑化（6505）受惠油價與利差擴大，盤中爆量急衝亮燈漲停，南亞（1303）漲幅逾5%，台塑（1301）、台化（1326）也有1%左右的漲幅。金融股亦扮演關鍵撐盤角色的重要支柱，富邦金（2881）強勢走揚，盤中最高來到161.5元，華南金（2880）盤中更飆漲逾3%衝上49.6元，雙雙刷新歷史新高紀錄。

此外，光學廠玉晶光（3406）亮燈創新天價，上漲105元，來到1175元，漲幅9.81%。被動元件族群也逆勢上漲，天二科技（6834）亮燈漲停，上漲14.5元，來到159.5元，漲幅10%。

news.Title: 【台股盤後】挫960點科技股賣壓沉重　塑化、航運與金融強勢
news.Content:
（中央社記者曾仁凱台北2026年10月13日電）博通執行長陳福陽、英特爾執行長陳立武雙雙示警，AI擴張最大瓶頸已非晶片，而是資金，引爆科技股賣壓，週一美國費城半導體指數連4黑，日、韓股今天也走弱，拖累台股今天盤中最多重跌逾1200點，回測48000點關卡。

終場集中市場指數下跌960.65點，收在48341.31點，成交值放大到新台幣1兆1250億元。

3大權值股方面，台積電 (2330) 今天收盤下跌50元或1.97%，收在2490元，聯發科 (2454) 跌100元或2.16%，收在4525元，台達電 (2308) 跌125元或6.58%，收1775元。

金融股成為撐盤要角，華南金 (2880) 大漲1.7元或3.57%，收49.35元；中信金 (2891) 、第一金 (2892) 收盤漲幅都超過2%。

台塑四寶昨天公布第3季自結財報，南亞 (1303) 、台塑化 (6505) 單季獲利創新高，外加油價上漲助攻，激勵塑化族群。台塑化今天收盤攻上漲停板119元，南亞大漲超過半根停板，二線塑化股，國喬 (1312) 亮燈漲停，東聯 (1710) 漲逾8%。

資深分析師蔡明翰分析，美國費城半導體今年以來漲幅大，最近出現比較明顯的拉回走勢，尤其在台灣國慶連假期間連續下跌。台股昨天連假後首日開低走高，展現抗跌力道，但該反映的還是得反映，今天台股下跌，日、韓股同樣偏弱。

不過蔡明翰觀察，這波費半指數回檔，美股主要指數走勢並非同步，如美國道瓊工業昨天上漲，顯示投資人並未恐慌，而且市場也沒有出現太特別的利空，族群輪動是好現象；本週頭號重點還是觀察週四即將登場的台積電法說會。

news.Title: 搭上三星與K-Pop ！「純韓股 ETF」009829遭韓股血洗慘跌7％
news.Content:
亞股今（13）日血洗！韓股跳水大跌逾6%，科技巨頭首當其衝，三星電子跌近7%，SK 海力士更殺近一成。作為全台唯一高純度涵蓋韓國前五十名市值龍頭的 ETF—大華韓國 KOSPI 50（009829），雖然精準卡位半導體記憶體霸主，並搭上韓流 K-Pop、韓國網漫與三星供應鏈等高成長題材，可惜生不逢時，今（13）日又遇到市場亂流。盤中一度重摔 7.59%；儘管尾盤跌勢略有收斂，終場仍大跌 6.81%，收在 9.58 元。

隨著市場焦點鎖定的三星電子第3季初步業績法說會，南韓股市（KOSPI）展開強烈攻防。009829經理人賴昱廷表示，儘管短線受韓元走升及美債殖利率波動影響，但南韓半導體出口暴增趨勢不變，對半導體龍頭的結構性需求依然堅堅挺。

在AI半導體與財報前景方面，賴昱廷表示，三星電子與SK海力士受惠於AI伺服器對HBM4與高階DRAM的強勁拉貨，記憶體庫存仍處於10天以下的極低狀態。雖然匯率波動帶來短線獲利調整疑慮，但AI記憶體供需失衡的結構性趨勢未變，市場預期三星電子法說會將釋出亮眼的HBM供應進展與資本支出展望，為晶片類股重奪KOSPI指數領頭羊地位提供有力支撐。

賴昱廷強調，009829（大華韓國KOSPI50）前兩大持股SK海力士（33.88%）、三星電子（31.24%）直接受惠於AI晶片超級週期與財報利多；同時囊括現代汽車、KB金融等受益於企業價值提升政策的低P/E高股息標的，以及引領全球流行文化輸出的娛樂消費與數位內容龍頭。在AI算力需求持續告急、政策改革與K-Culture全球紅利同步發酵的背景下，建議投資人不妨透過009829布局南韓龍頭企業，跨國資金重估趨勢下，作為資產配置效益的核心選擇。

但賴昱廷也提醒，市場仍受總體經濟及國際政經變化干擾，投資人應評估自身風險承受度，以單筆分批或定期定額方式進行中長期規劃。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 韓股血崩7％不只記憶體開槍！還有2大隱形殺手 大老竟爆市場像在「賭場」
news.Content:
韓國股市今（13）日盤中一度崩跌7%，兩大指標權值股三星電子與 SK 海力士股價重挫7%至 8%，短短 4個交易日大盤累計暴跌15%。韓股10月2日收在 7003 點，今日最低下探5911 點，一度摜破年線5990點，距離7月底股災低點5262點僅剩約一成距離。若跌勢持續，本周不排除見到前波低點。

綜合外媒報導，南韓曾是全球熱門的AI交易市場之一。在AI熱潮推動下，記憶體晶片利潤飆升，槓桿散戶與海外資金集中湧入，KOSPI指數上半年一度上漲約一倍。然而進入下半年，行情迅速反轉，指數下挫 22%，成為同期表現最差的市場之一；然而美股卻持續走高。

權重過度集中半導體 投機資金退潮爆賣壓

Bloomberg Markets Live策略師指出，這場反轉並不代表AI基礎設施需求崩潰，核心問題在於南韓股市過度依賴少數半導體巨頭。當投機資金退潮後，市場缺乏足夠買盤承接拋售賣壓。

博通執行長陳福陽日前警告，資金緊縮可能成爲比晶片短缺最大的瓶頸。他於新加坡一場公開活動中指出，許多投資人並不清楚自身的投資標的，設定了非常極端的期望，這讓市場操作幾乎就像在賭場一樣。

與此同時，大陸記憶體指標廠長鑫科技近期宣布在4F² DRAM架構研發取得關鍵突破，預計年底推出結合 4F² 與混合鍵合（Hybrid Bonding）技術的新一代 DDR5 RDIMM 伺服器記憶體。若新產品順利通過客戶認證，將顯著拉升長鑫在伺服器記憶體的市場版圖。

55兆韓元庫藏股支撐消失 外資持續撤離韓股

Pepperstone 集團研究策略師Dilin Wu指出，三星與SK海力士在KOSPI指數的權重極高，全球市場對AI行情的所有疑慮，都會在首爾股市被大幅放大。另一方面，長鑫科技的技術突破，也直接踩中投資人關注的核心問題，即南韓記憶體巨頭的競爭優勢究竟還能維持多久？

南韓股市總市值約 4.3 兆美元，三星與 SK 海力士合計佔KOSPI權重超過一半，使指數高度依賴記憶體產業的盈利前景與市場情緒。

另一項利空在於兩家公司的股票回購計畫接近尾聲。三星與SK海力士回購規模合計55兆韓元（約 4100億美元）。摩根大通估計，兩家公司回購貢獻了上月南韓股市買盤的大部分動力。隨著護盤資金退場，市場急需尋找新資金承接股票。但在

但在外資持續撤離、散戶降低槓桿的情況下，即便企業獲利維持成長，缺乏新資金流入也難以推升股價迅速反彈。

news.Title: 台股收盤重挫960點！台積電暴跌50元 3大族群苦撐紅盤
news.Content:
台股今（13日）開低走低，盤中一度大跌1235點，隨後跌勢略為收斂，終場下跌960.65點收在48341.31點，成交量1.12兆元。權值股台積電跌50元收在2490元，台達電挫低125元收在1775元，聯發科也下跌100元收在4525元，電子股成為重災區，光通訊、記憶體、矽晶圓、被動元件、CCL及PCB等熱門族群皆被擊落，僅傳產航運塑化與金融族群收紅。

近期美股高估值族群出現回檔，費城半導體指數成為重災區，加上國際油價上漲，通膨疑慮再起，使人工智慧產業的利空與質疑又被放大，美股下殺後台日韓股市也急跌，日股跌逾2%，韓股重挫逾6%。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指，台股面臨補跌壓力，美股科技股連續回檔，費半指數重挫2.67%，台積電ADR跌破月線，加上外資持續提款，電子權值股面臨賣壓。資金轉向塑化、航運，中小型股則以個股表現為主。

林漢偉建議投資人多看少做，控制資金水位，嚴防外資提款壓力，電子權值股面臨賣壓，中小型股則會轉為個股表現的游擊戰，「台股補跌回測十日線壓力沉重，應汰弱留強不亂搶反彈，避開位階偏高的電子股，把資金轉進具備實質受惠油價的塑化族群，或者9月營收亮眼的個股，保持耐心度過亂流。」

法人認為，投資人後市需要觀察3大止跌訊號，包括匯率走勢、法人籌碼及技術面表現，外資是否重站買方、新台幣是否大幅升值帶動資金回流，或者出現帶量的紅K棒及長下影線。

news.Title: AI「錢荒」來了？美股AI拋售潮外溢  韓股早盤挫7%熔斷、日股跌超3%  鎧陜崩逾13%
news.Content:
一場由美股AI硬體股引發的拋售潮週二(13日)蔓延至亞洲，韓股早盤跌逾7%、摜破6000點，觸發SIDECAR暫停KOSPI程式賣盤，三星電子跌超8%、SK海力士跌超9%，日股也在同日補跌，日經225跌超3%、一度挫逾1700點，鎧俠早盤崩跌13.2%、軟銀跌8.2%。MSCI亞太指數亦創逾兩個月低，A股創業板早盤跌逾3%，香港恒生科技跌超2%，算力硬體、半導體、大型科技股齊挫。

Lumentum在美股週一(12日)跌近10%，康寧、閃迪跌約6%，美光、希捷跌超3%，安謀、SK海力士跌超4%，甲骨文跌近3%，輝達跌超1%。

英特爾、博通執行長近日直言，AI擴張最大瓶頸已非晶片而是資金，雲廠資本開支續增，但自由現金流承壓，長天期美債利率偏高推升資料中心融資成本。市場對「需求永動機」敘事重新定價，轉向檢視資本開支可持續性與投資回報。

橋水創辦人達利歐在新加坡福布斯全球CEO大會警告，AI投資熱已是「經典泡沫」，受債務融資與利率上行驅動，距破裂臨界點「已很近」。

分析人士認為，長線算力需求未消失，但高估值正接受融資成本與現金流壓力考驗，亞洲半導體權重股短期波動恐延續。縱觀全球AI行情，本輪調整的本質是市場對AI敘事的一次集中重定價。過去一年全球科技股的定價核心邏輯是「算力即權力」，但隨著AI資本開支規模不斷擴大，市場開始追問一個更現實的問題：這筆錢從哪裡來？

短期來看，恐慌情緒仍在跨市場傳導，高估值科技股與利率敏感的半導體族群仍將面臨波動壓力。

不過，市場認為，AI基本面未徹底反轉，算力長期需求邏輯沒有消失，變動的是估價定價邏輯。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》AI與半導體走弱 日經指數下跌2.5%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-13 10:35:41 黃文章 發佈

日經指數週二早盤下跌，受到前一交易日美國半導體類股下跌影響，人工智慧（AI）與半導體相關股票幾乎全面走低。軟銀集團（SoftBank Group）股價下跌8.5%，也成為拖累日經平均指數走勢的因素。

日經225指數13日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)下跌2.52%或1,738.53點，暫收67,292.39點。東證股價指數(TOPIX)早盤收盤下跌0.46%或18.90點，暫收4,085.91點。

就類股表現來看，截至早盤收盤為止，海運業（2.66%）、證券業（2.00%）漲幅較大，跌幅較大的類股為非鐵金屬（-4.52%）、電氣機器（-3.21%）。

一名日本國內證券公司的策略師表示：「若要讓日經平均指數在7萬點站穩，其中一項必要條件，是觀察10月下半月起正式展開的4月至9月期財報發布，確認AI與半導體相關產業的需求是否持續擴大。」

另一方面，由於中東局勢日益緊張，原油價格維持在高檔，帶動能源類股受到買盤青睞。此外，市場預期通膨加速可能推升未來利率，銀行、保險等有利於利率上升的金融類股也隨之走高。

news.Title: Is Western Digital (WDC) a Good or Bad Investment at Today’s Price?
news.Content:
Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ: WDC ) closed at $397.28 on October 9. The stock has returned 13.4% during the last six months, compared to a 24.3% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 15.1% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust.

Western Digital reports a net margin no hardware manufacturer has ever sustained. Storage has a long history of destroying anyone who mistakes a shortage for a moat. This is a shortage.

READ ALSO: 10 Best Undervalued Stocks to Buy in October

The Profit Came From a Shareholding, Not From Drives:

No storage company keeps nearly three-quarters of its revenue as profit, and this one did not either. Western Digital separated its flash memory business as SanDisk in February 2025 and retained a stake. Accounting rules require that retained interest be marked to market, and SanDisk shares rose a long way. The resulting gain is most of the reported profit.

The cash statement confirms it plainly. Free cash flow came in at a fraction of reported net income, and that spread is the shareholding rather than the drives. Strip it out and what remains is genuinely strong, because the operating margin of 43.61% belongs to Western Digital and it is a remarkable number for storage hardware. Revenue grew 43.80% as data centres bought high-capacity drives faster than the industry could build them, on a balance sheet carrying barely a billion of debt. The stake itself is in a chip business, which is the sector doing the work here and the reason so much money sits in the semiconductors billionaires added to this year . Their most-held name is up 18% since June.

DON'T MISS: 10 Best Stocks to Buy for High Returns in 2026

This Is What a Cycle Top Looks Like:

Storage is cyclical, and this is what the top of a cycle looks like. Drive prices rose because buyers wanted capacity faster than it could be manufactured, not because Western Digital won share.

That matters for how the multiple should be read. A cyclical trades at its lowest earnings multiple precisely when its earnings are highest, which is the opposite of a bargain signal. Micron spent years looking cheap on exactly this arithmetic and expensive once memory pricing turned.

Capacity is already being added across the industry, which is the predictable response to margins like these. The question is not whether supply arrives but when. Cheapest multiple at the highest earnings is the oldest trap in commodities, and avoiding it is most of what separates a cyclical from the high return list we published in January . The one we ranked first there is up 24% since.

Story Continues

The shares rose over six months without keeping pace with the market, and they still sit far below their 52-week high, which gives some sense of how violent the swings here are.

The Valuation Case:

On earnings, the stock trades at 12.40 times forward, on analyst consensus estimates, and that figure is not a bargain signal for the reasons above. The price-to-book of 18.99 is the measure that does not flatter the company, and it is the one that survives a pricing reversal. You are paying nineteen times the stated value of the assets for a manufacturer at a cyclical peak.

The verdict is that Western Digital looks cheap on peak earnings and expensive on assets, which is the classic profile of a cyclical at the top. Both things are true, and only one of them persists through a downturn. The operating business deserves credit, and the price does not reflect a permanent rerating. Profit that does not depend on a shortage is a different kind of cheap altogether, and that is what the profitable stocks we judged most underpriced are built on. Their leader has returned 16% since.

Conclusion:

Two businesses are buried in this income statement, and only one of them makes drives. The one that does grew revenue sharply at an exceptional operating margin, on a balance sheet carrying almost no debt. However, the net margin comes mostly from marking a retained SanDisk shareholding, and free cash flow arrived well below reported net income. The forward multiple is what a storage company looks like at the top of a pricing cycle rather than what a cheap one looks like. Everything comes back to price-to-book, the one figure that does not fall away when drive prices do.

Market Sentiment:

Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) was held by 98 hedge funds with a combined stake value of about $9.94 billion at the end of Q2 2026 in the Insider Monkey database. This is up from 83 hedge fund holders with a cumulative investment value of around $6.57 billion in the previous quarter.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of WDC as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. news.Title: 群益投信Q4投資展望，聚焦「DUO」策略，兼顧成長收益
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】今年第三季雖受通膨升溫、AI變現疑慮影響，全球金融市場呈現高檔震盪，但整體經濟展現韌性，基本面、企業獲利與資金動能同步增強，評價面經過回檔修正後回到合理區間，為後續行情奠定基礎。展望第四季，群益投信表示，利率變化仍將牽動市場風險偏好，但隨AI應用加速擴散、企業營運續旺，多頭格局可望延續，短期波動反而提供重新檢視與布局的契機。面對機會與挑戰並存的環境，投資人可採用「DUO」高效投資策略，以多工處理（Multi-tasking）的理財思維進行股債多元配置，掌握科技趨勢與成長契機，同時建立收益與防禦機制，靈活因應市場變化，打造攻守兼備的投資組合，在震盪中穩健前行。群益投信指出，「DUO」高效投資策略中的「D」代表Diversify多元分散風險，今年來全球金融市場震盪頻繁，穩健型投資人可透過「先固息、後增益」架構，利用多重資產基金、目標風險組合平衡基金，或結合具有高息優勢的債券基金及ETF，像是金融債基金、非投等債基金、優先順位非投等債基金、短天期ESG BBB級投等債ETF、優選非投等債ETF等，以獲得穩建息收並降低投組波動。「U」為Upside Trend 掌握上行趨勢，在AI需求強勁與應用落地，以及大廠資本支出加速下，台美科技供應鏈獲利維持高成長，成為推升台股、美股向上的核心動能。投資人可透過主動式台股ETF、台股基金、主動式美股ETF、市值型美股ETF、科技型美股ETF、美國成長股基金，以參與AI核心商機。

群益投信進一步說明，「O」則是Opportunity捕捉潛力機會，尤其印度受惠於政策利多、內需強勁，有利股市重返成長格局，有意參與補漲行情的投資人可適度配置印度相關股票基金。此外，日本自首相高市早苗上任後，積極推動各項改革政策，並邁向利率正常化，為日本經濟注入新動能。看好日股紅利的投資人，不妨透過以日股為核心部位的亞股基金來掌握新多頭行情。整體來看，「DUO」高效投資策略協助投資人抵禦波動，同時掌握潛在商機，以從容應對重啟升息後的經濟新局，同時達成資產穩健增值的理財目標。

升息短空長多，首選科技成長股、大型股、新興亞股、短債，兼顧成長收益

群益環球金綻雙喜基金經理人許書銘表示，中東戰事推升油價並加劇通膨壓力，促使聯準會重啟升息，主要央行也轉趨鷹派，全球進入高利率維持更久的新局面。不過歷史經驗顯示，升息對股市影響往往呈現「短空長多」，尤其在AI投資週期加速下，全球製造業PMI持續擴張，有助企業營運改善。預期企業獲利的強勁表現可望支撐升息初期的估值修正，待市場消化政策衝擊後，投資焦點仍將回到基本面。

許書銘進一步指出，面對經濟發展穩健、貨幣政策轉向的環境，第四季操作仍以股優於債為主，在股市布局上，隨著AI資本支出加速，可鎖定獲利能見度最高的科技成長股、財務體質良好的大型股，以及受惠於半導體超級週期的新興亞股。債券配置上，因應利率環境變化，短債表現相對受惠，可善用具收益優勢的非投等債、新興債建立穩健現金流來源，並強化投組防禦力。

高利率環境疊加企業獲利加速，美股進入成長淘汰賽，科技硬體仍是投資主線

群益美國科技巨頭ETF（009824）經理人李晉含指出，雖然市場面臨升息與資金成本提高的挑戰，但企業獲利的強勁增長足以抵銷估值壓力，市場表現依然穩健，今年前三季標普500指數上漲11.8%，屢創新高，同時企業獲利持續上修，使未來12個月本益比從年初的22.2倍降至19.1倍，顯示整體評價仍屬合理。然而，隨著利率走高，市場將更嚴格檢視AI商業化進程、自由現金流與變現能力，市場將進入企業層級的成長淘汰賽。後續可關注債券殖利率、油價走勢，操作上也須留意第四季財測與市場廣度變化。產業布局上，在市場最為關切的AI領域，在模型突破、硬體擴建、資本回收與代理商業化同時發展下，市場注意力形成四層重疊，角度也自能否建成延伸至能否應用、收費並留下現金，現階段來看，市場對接下來最高成長預期仍集中於AI基礎設施，相關硬體獲利可望延續，料為資金匯集之處，非電族群則可留意包括金融、航太與能源，以掌握個股輪動下的投資契機。

群益亞太新趨勢平衡基金經理人楊慈珍認為，受惠於全球AI需求殷切，亞洲科技產品出口與資本支出顯著增加，帶動區域今、明兩年GDP年增率上看4.8%、4.7%。雖然地緣政治風險加重通膨壓力，但部分亞太國家已啟動升息並逐步接近本輪利率目標，加上各國推行緩和物價政策，預估後續升息空間有限。從估值來看，目前MSCI亞太不含日本指數本益比僅10.5倍，明顯低於歐美股市，兼具評價優勢與長線投資價值。產業面來看，AI應用拓展帶動AI硬體需求，後續看好具缺貨題材、訂單能見度高，且受惠AI長期成長趨勢的科技、工業、非必須消費產業。操作上可分批布局以待行情發動，同時密切追蹤總經動能以及企業財報變化，以利汰弱留強。

群益馬拉松基金暨主動群益台灣強棒ETF（00982A）經理人陳沅易分析，儘管聯準會立場偏鷹、美債殖利率走升一度影響市場情緒，不過核心通膨逐步降溫、薪資與物價螺旋上升的風險亦低，長期利率壓力有望淡化。此外，待後續美國期中選舉結果出爐，政治、政策不確定性可望消退，市場焦點也將更回歸聚焦基本面。隨著AI應用需求大爆發，推升相關供應鏈獲利表現，預估今年台股企業獲利成長率上修至40%，明年將再成長25%，不僅進一步強化市場信心，也有助支持台股多頭延續。投資配置上，AI長期成長趨勢仍是核心主軸，可關注先進製程、先進封裝、廠務工程、矽光子、測試介面、PCB/CCL、ASIC及低軌衛星等獲利成長動能強勁族群，以掌握AI發展所帶來的成長紅利。

news.Title: S&P upgrades SanDisk to BBB as AI memory demand drives cash flow past $23B
news.Content:
Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK). to 'BBB' from 'BB+' on Monday, citing a sharp surge in artificial intelligence-driven demand for memory chips and a pristine, debt-free balance sheet. The credit rating agency maintained a stable outlook for the NAND flash memory producer, highlighting robust cash generation and significant financial cushion to absorb potential industry downturns.

The upgrade follows a transformative period of growth for SanDisk, driven by a tight supply-demand imbalance in the global flash memory market. Fueled by exponential growth in AI data center infrastructure, the company posted a 175% revenue surge in fiscal 2026 as pricing skyrocketed across all business segments.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

Looking ahead, S&P expects SanDisk's momentum to accelerate into fiscal 2027, projecting revenue to double and free cash flow to surpass $23 billion. Operating profitability is anticipated to expand further as the company ramps up lower-cost technology and benefits from high-margin data center contracts featuring volume commitments and price protections.

While memory markets remain historically cyclical and prone to sudden price corrections, SanDisk's conservative balance sheet structure provides substantial risk mitigation. The company repaid all of its funded debt earlier in the year and is expected to maintain a net cash position even as capital expenditures increase and excess capital is returned to shareholders.

Against that backdrop, long-term supply agreement commitments from data center customers are providing enhanced earnings visibility compared to traditional PC and mobile markets. S&P noted that while new supply capacity from competitors could emerge by 2028, SanDisk's balance sheet retains ample strength to navigate future market shifts.

news.Title: AI Is Blowing Up Tech’s Money Rules. How Arm Could Make Qualcomm Pay More.
news.Content:
Artificial intelligence is doing more than changing what technology companies sell. It is testing the agreements that decide who gets paid when those products succeed. A licensing deal that looked sensible in the smartphone era can look painfully cheap once the same technology powers sprawling data centers. Meanwhile, content once given away to attract readers has become raw material for competing AI services.

Investors riding the AI infrastructure spending boom should take note: owning essential technology doesn't guarantee a bigger share of its value.

More News from Barchart

'When You Say I Should Pay $100 Billion, Then I'm Starting To Do A Little Math': Bill Gates Said He'd Happily Pay 'Over $10 Billion In Taxes' But Some Are Asking Too Much

Dan Ives Calls SpaceX's $40B Nvidia Chip Debt Plan a 'Smart Move'

Dear Johnson & Johnson Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for October 13

Get exclusive insights with the FREE Barchart Brief newsletter. Subscribe now for quick, incisive midday market analysis you won't find anywhere else.

Qualcomm and Arm's $1.88 Problem

That tension is on full display in the courtroom fight between Qualcomm (QCOM) and Arm Holdings (ARM) over an architecture licensing agreement dating to 2013. Oddly, Arm is now criticizing the very terms it wrote.

According to Reuters , the agreement caps royalties at $1.88 per chip containing at least five processor cores. Arm's lawyer contrasted that with data center processors containing 288 cores, asking whether Qualcomm was paying for five and "getting 283 for free." Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon rejected that characterization.

The stakes cut both ways. For Qualcomm, a capped fee protects margins as its chips grow more capable. For Arm, it limits the revenue it can capture from that growing complexity. And because Qualcomm's license runs through 2033, access to future technology, and what it costs, is central to the dispute.

Arm has another route to monetization, though. Its June-quarter SEC filing describes the March 2026 launch of its own AGI CPU, underscoring a shift from licensing toward selling silicon.

A little arithmetic shows why this matters. On a hypothetical $100 chip, a $1.88 royalty is 1.88% of sales. On a $1,000 chip, it shrinks to 0.188%. These are illustrations, not Qualcomm's actual prices, but they show how a fixed fee lets a chipmaker keep more revenue as product value rises. A pricier chip also costs more to design and build, so the difference isn't pure profit.

Still, the distinction is useful. Arm shareholders should separate more chips shipped from more revenue earned per chip. Qualcomm shareholders face the opposite question: how much of today's cost advantage will survive negotiations over tomorrow's technology?

Story Continues

AI Is Repricing Content Too

A similar reset is underway online. Reddit (RDDT) disclosed in its 2024 IPO prospectus that its January data-licensing agreements totaled $203 million over two to three years. That figure is the contracted value, not cash already collected. Because these contracts are shorter than Arm's, Reddit gets more frequent chances to revisit pricing.

Charging AI companies has its own trade-off, however. Their answers can reduce the need to visit the original source, and Reddit's slowing user growth shows that monetizing content and protecting audience engagement are separate challenges.

Microsoft (MSFT) took a different approach on Feb. 3 with its Publisher Content Marketplace, which lets publishers set licensing terms and provides usage reporting. The announcement explicitly acknowledged that the web's old bargain of content in exchange for referral traffic doesn't translate cleanly to AI.

Key Takeaway

As for the Qualcomm-Arm case, Reuters reports that the Delaware jury deliberated for roughly four hours on Oct. 9 without reaching a verdict and plans to return on Oct. 13. But the tension over these contracts will remain whichever way the jury decides.

AI demand alone is an incomplete investment thesis. The better bets are businesses that can turn rising usage into cash without undermining customer relationships or their original source of revenue.

For now, keep QCOM and ARM stocks on your watchlist rather than buying either on courtroom speculation. Watch for the verdict, future licensing terms, and evidence that Arm's silicon expansion produces profitable growth. Arm's $1.88 fee illustrates the problem, but it is enforceable pricing power that determines who collects the payoff.

news.Title: Sandisk Stocks Fall 5.7% Although Goldman Sees a New AI-Memory Opportunity
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Sandisk, the flash-memory supplier ( NASDAQ:SNDK ), faces a profitability test behind its AI-memory opportunity, with shares down 5.7% to $1,491.35 at 12:41 p.m. ET on Monday. Investing.com's October 12 report outlined Goldman Sachs' bullish case for high-bandwidth flash, or HBF. The opportunity is clear. The harder question is how much profit Sandisk can squeeze from the factory capacity needed to deliver it.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Signs with SNDK.

Is SNDK fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Sandisk and SK hynix released an Open Compute Project technical specification on August 3, with Google and Tenstorrent contributing to validation and standardization. The framework supports AI systems that place more memory near computing cores and allows HBF to work alongside high-bandwidth memory. That gives designers a foundation to build on. It does not guarantee orders. The GF Score of 45/100 shows strong growth and financial-strength readings alongside weaker profitability, suggesting investors should look beyond the growth story.

According to Investing.com, Goldman's optimistic scenario puts HBF at 9% of global NAND wafer capacity but just 4% of bit shipments by late 2028. Those shares imply a 2.25-to-one ratio of capacity share to shipment share. My take: heavier wafer consumption could tighten supply and support pricing, but it also raises the bar for returns. Sandisk still needs customer approvals, reliable manufacturing yields and prices that reward the capacity consumed. Technical progress opens the door. Profitable orders make the investment case.

news.Title: SK Hynix Stocks Fall 3.6% Although Goldman Backs Its Next AI-Memory Bet
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

SK hynix, the Korean memory-chip producer ( NASDAQ:SKHY ), slipped to $163.01, down about 3.6% at 12.40pm EST on October 12, despite Goldman Sachs' support for its high-bandwidth-flash technology, according to Investing.com. The opportunity is clear: AI systems need faster access to larger pools of data. The commercial payoff is less certain. Goldman sees promise in the company's HBF expertise, but system development remains early.

The technical roadmap has numbers behind it. Its UCIe interface aims to connect the technology with different processors, including CPUs and GPUs. That could broaden adoption. news.Title: Sandisk stock is this bull market's emergent star
news.Content: Sandisk stock ( SNDK ) has soared over 3,000% since its IPO a year and a half ago. As Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman pointed out on this fourth anniversary of the bull market , Sandisk has had the best performance of any S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) stock, outrunning Palantir (No. 2, up 2,490%), Vertiv (No. 3, up 2,125%), Nvidia (No. 4, up 1,894%), and Micron (No. 5, up 1,851%). There's one caveat to that title: Sandisk's incredible run is purely a 2025-2026 story. In February 2025, Western Digital ( WDC ) spun off its flash memory unit, and Sandisk began trading as its own entity at $52 per share, according to Yahoo Finance data. As of 2 p.m. ET, shares of Sandisk are trading at $1,479, and the company boasts a market cap of over $200 billion. (Sandisk and other chip names are falling on Monday after a memory innovation from a Chinese company.) Following Sandisk's listing, the company benefited from surging demand for NAND data storage technology, driven by the AI data center build-out and companies training generative AI models. In recent quarters, Sandisk's data center business has accounted for a quarter to a third of its overall revenue as the AI memory supply bottleneck has given memory makers like Sandisk enormous pricing power. At the company's investor day in August, Sandisk's management shared a bullish outlook for annual revenue growth in the mid-to-high teens between 2028 and 2030. The company also forecast non-GAAP gross margins at about 80%. Even among other memory stocks, like Micron ( MU ), Sandisk emerges as a highflier, though Micron's comparable 979% gain since Sandisk's IPO date is nothing to sneeze at. Micron produces DRAM and high-bandwidth memory, as well as NAND. The overwhelming takeaway from this bull market is that the AI build-out is minting the next wave of stock winners. From Nvidia, which designs the chips and hardware that go into data centers, to Palantir, which produces the software that runs the application layer, to Vertiv, which creates the technology to regulate data centers' power and temperatures, artificial intelligence has powered this bull market — which coincided with the release of OpenAI's ( OPAI.PVT ) ChatGPT. news.Title: Not Sandisk, Not Intel. This Stock Will Lead the S&P 500 Next Year
news.Content:
The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) has had a great year so far. The average annual return of the S&P 500 is about 10%, and with it sitting at about 14.5% right now, it has been a good year. There are still a few months left, so the chances of it ending up even higher are quite good.

While the S&P 500 as a whole is doing well, a few individual performers stand out. Sandisk holds the title for best-performing S&P 500 stock this year, rising about 590% in 2026. Intel is another top performer, increasing nearly 200% so far this year. There are a handful of companies that also have had strong runs, including AMD .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

So, which stock will lead the S&P 500 higher next year? I think it will be a familiar face, and it won't be one of these three.

Some stocks have gotten ahead of themselves

With the returns some stocks are delivering this year, it's pretty easy to guess that next year may not be as kind to these stocks. Many companies have far outgrown their business results and are trading at inflated valuations, such as Intel and AMD. These two trade for 70 and 81 times forward earnings, respectively. This showcases just how expensive they are. Others, like Sandisk, operate in a cyclical market, and the stock market is wary of giving it a standard valuation due to fears of the memory chip industry seeing a cyclical downturn.

Regardless, there are a handful of stocks that were abandoned to pave the way for these to rise, and the most obvious one is Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA). Nvidia led the S&P 500 in performance during 2023 and 2024, and I think it has a strong shot at leading it again in 2027. Why? Its stock has been ignored compared to some of its peers.

Nvidia is dirt cheap compared to its peers

It's hard to say that the largest company in the world by market cap isn't getting a fair shake, but that's exactly what's happening. As mentioned above, AMD trades at over 80 times forward earnings. Nvidia trades at 25.

AMD PE Ratio (Forward) data by YCharts

These two companies operate in the same industry (namely, graphics processing units , or GPUs), and Nvidia is growing its data center business (the segment most exposed to artificial intelligence (AI)) at a faster pace. In Q2, Nvidia's data center division grew at a 117% pace to $89 billion. AMD's data center division grew at a 107% pace to $6.7 billion. Nvidia is still winning, and there's no reason to give AMD a ridiculous premium as a result.

Story Continues

Another factor is that the market hasn't priced in practically any of 2027's growth into Nvidia's stock price. The S&P 500 trades for about 20 times forward earnings. The slight premium Nvidia now commands is worth it given its positioning in the AI boom and strong track record of performance. However, Nvidia is also expected to grow its revenue by 70% next year. But Nvidia's current 25 times forward earnings valuation implies that its stock will grow at a market-average pace next year (about 10%).

That's a major mismatch, and I think it suggests Nvidia is poised for an exceptional year and could lead the S&P 500 in performance. While there could be others that sneak up on investors and outperform Nvidia, Nvidia is one of the few companies that has given investors high visibility into its future growth. Management has undergirded nearly every step along the way, so this 70% growth could also be a major undershoot.

With Nvidia expected to grow revenue by 70% or more next year, I think it's a no-brainer buy right now.

news.Title: Prediction: Sandisk Stock Will Be Worth This Much at the End of 2026
news.Content:
Since spinning off from Western Digital in February 2025, Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) has become one of the biggest beneficiaries of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure boom. Over the past year, Sandisk stock has soared 1,100%. In 2026 alone, its gain of 570% makes it the second best performer in the Nasdaq-100 .

Yet despite its extraordinary price appreciation, Sandisk trades at a modest valuation. With memory shortages potentially extending through 2028, could Sandisk's valuation actually be too conservative?

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

How the memory shortage is benefiting Sandisk

Sandisk specializes in NAND flash memory, a technology used to power solid-state drives, smartphones, computers, and storage systems. While Nvidia GPUs receive most of the attention surrounding AI chips, the enormous amounts of data generated by those accelerators must be stored somewhere. That's creating a powerful tailwind for storage suppliers.

During its late September earnings report, Micron Technology indicated that memory supply bottlenecks could persist through 2027 and 2028. This commentary aligns with Sandisk's management, which has previously highlighted how strong customer demand is limiting supply.

So far, the memory boom has made a dramatic financial impact on Sandisk. The company generated $20.3 billion in revenue during fiscal 2026, representing 175% year-over-year growth. Meanwhile, Wall Street expects fiscal 2027 revenue to approach $49 billion, more than doubling again. For a historically cyclical industry, these are encouraging growth numbers.

Sandisk's valuation still has room to expand

Wall Street expects Sandisk to generate approximately $215 in earnings per share during fiscal 2027. At a share price around $1,585, that translates into a forward price-to-earnings ratio of just 7.4. That looks inexpensive given the company's explosive revenue and profit growth.

SNDK Revenue (TTM) data by YCharts

It's important to note that memory manufacturers have historically traded at lower multiples because their profitability is more sensitive to supply and demand dynamics. When memory prices fall, earnings can erode surprisingly quickly.

But what if this AI-driven cycle is different? If AI infrastructure demand continues accelerating while NAND production remains constrained, Sandisk should enjoy unusually strong earnings for several years. This is what makes the company's shift toward multi-year customer agreements so savvy, as they provide more predictable revenue and earnings potential. In turn, growth investors could begin to assign Sandisk stock a higher valuation multiple.

Story Continues

Where could Sandisk stock trade by December?

In a downside scenario, investors may become concerned about weakening NAND prices or an eventual supply glut. If Sandisk were to trade at 5.5 times projected earnings, shares could retreat toward $1,182, representing about 25% downside to today's prices.

What I think is most realistic is Micron's supply outlook will prove accurate following Sandisk's upcoming earnings report on Oct. 29. At that time, investors could become more comfortable expanding the multiple. At nine times forward earnings, Sandisk would trade at approximately $1,935, implying 22% upside.

In a particularly bullish scenario, Sandisk's guidance could trigger both upward earnings revisions and multiple expansion. At 11 times projected earnings, Sandisk could approach $2,365, representing roughly 49% upside.

All told, I see a reasonable path toward $1,900 by year's end. Smart investors understand that Sandisk's modest valuation profile could reflect peak-cycle earnings rather than a genuine bargain. Nevertheless, secular tailwinds suggest Sandisk will continue benefiting from AI infrastructure demand and constrained memory supply. Against this backdrop, Sandisk looks like a compelling semiconductor stock to buy and hold as AI infrastructure continues to accelerate.

news.Title: Can NVTS' Alliance With Microchip Accelerate Its AI Power Growth?
news.Content:
Navitas Semiconductor NVTS is expanding its AI data center opportunity through its collaboration with Microchip Technology. The companies have developed an 800V DC-to-6V DC reference design for next-generation AI data center racks. The solution combines Microchip's digital power control and security technologies with NVTS' GaN power devices and is aligned with the Open Compute Project's 800V DC standard. The reference design includes hardware, software and design documentation to help data center developers reduce design time and bring new power systems to market faster.

The reference design uses NVTS' 650V GaNFast FETs and Microchip's dsPIC33AK digital signal controllers and TA100 CryptoAuthentication device. The system is designed to deliver up to 96% peak efficiency at full load, with a power density of 2,100 watts per cubic inch. It directly converts 800V DC to 6V DC by combining the 800V-to-50V and 50V-to-6V stages into a single converter. This approach is aimed at improving power conversion efficiency while supporting compact rack power systems.

The collaboration comes as AI data centers require higher power density and more efficient power delivery. Navitas has been focusing on this market as part of its broader shift toward high-power applications. In the second quarter of 2026, NVTS' high-power markets grew more than 50% year over year, while AI infrastructure is expected to account for more than one-third of total sales by the end of 2026. The company is also working on multiple AI data center programs tied to the transition toward 800V architectures.

The Microchip collaboration could help NVTS strengthen its position as more data center operators adopt 800V power systems. By combining NVTS' GaN technology with Microchip's digital control and security capabilities, the companies are offering customers a more complete solution for AI rack power. As 800V adoption expands, the new reference design could help NVTS gain additional design opportunities in the growing AI data center market.

How Competitors Fare Against NVTS

The company faces strong competition from ON Semiconductor ON and STMicroelectronics STM in the race to supply high-voltage solutions for AI data centers.

ON is expanding its presence in AI data center power as the industry moves toward 800V DC architectures. The company expects AI data center revenues to more than double in 2026, while silicon carbide revenues from AI data center applications are expected to grow nearly 60% year over year. The company expects its high-voltage revenues to accelerate as data centers adopt 800V DC distribution, increasing demand for its power solutions across the AI power tree.

Story Continues

STMicroelectronics is another semiconductor company gaining from rising AI data center power demand. The company reported 50% year-over-year growth in communication equipment and computer peripherals in the second quarter, supported by its AI-related customer programs. STM is already supplying microcontrollers, high-voltage power and analog products for the power stage of cloud AI systems and is building a pipeline for low-voltage power solutions. The company expects data center revenues to exceed $1 billion in 2026 and $2 billion in 2027 if current trends continue.

Shares of Navitas Semiconductor have rallied 51% year to date compared with the Zacks Electronics – Semiconductors industry's growth of 31%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

news.Title: Semtech Rises 154% YTD: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
news.Content:
Semtech Corporation SMTC shares have surged 154.1% year to date (YTD), outperforming the Zacks Semiconductor - Analog and Mixed industry's growth of 45.2%. The stock also outperformed its industry peers, including Microchip Technology MCHP, ON Semiconductor ON and NXP Semiconductors NXPI. YTD, shares of Microchip Technology, ON Semiconductor and NXP Semiconductors have gained 18.6%, 43.1% and 4.8%, respectively.

The outperformance of SMTC's shares raises the question: Does it still have room to run, or is it time for investors to consider taking profits? Let's find out.

YTD Price Return Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Semtech's 1.6T Ramp to Drive Data Center Growth

Semtech is seeing strong demand for its data center products as hyperscalers increase spending on AI infrastructure. The company's data center revenues reached a record $100 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, up 39% sequentially and 91% year over year. Growth was driven by continued strength in 800G products, along with the ramp of 1.6T CopperEdge and FiberEdge solutions. Management expects this momentum to continue, with data center revenues projected to increase 45% sequentially and 160% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

The 1.6T transition could become an important growth driver for Semtech. Management expects 1.6T FiberEdge and CopperEdge products to account for more than 50% of total data center revenues in the third quarter of fiscal 2027. Semtech is also gaining market share in optical connectivity, where its FiberEdge business has grown from about 18% market share in 800G two years ago to more than 50%. Further, the company expects its 1.6T FiberEdge market share to exceed 50% by the end of fiscal 2027.

The company is also preparing for the next stage of data center growth. Semtech is expanding its photonics portfolio through gain chips, high-power CW lasers, semiconductor optical amplifiers and photodiodes. These products are aimed at higher-speed applications, including 3.2T transceivers and co-packaged optics. Management expects its content per transceiver to increase from high single-digit dollars to high double-digit dollars as data center speeds move from 800G to 3.2T.

Strong customer demand supports SMTC's prospects as well, with the company reporting that its backlog for the remainder of fiscal 2027 was fully booked and more than 70% of its target for fiscal 2028 was already covered. Management is also working with manufacturing partners to secure additional capacity for fiscal 2028 and beyond. If it can meet customer requirements and maintain its product momentum, the 1.6T ramp could remain an important driver of Semtech's data center growth over the next several quarters.

Story Continues

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for SMTC's fiscal 2027 and 2028 revenues indicates year-over-year growth of 41.5% and 28.5%, respectively.

Strong LoRa Growth Boosts SMTC's Prospects

Semtech is seeing strong growth in its LoRa business as demand increases across industrial, commercial and consumer applications. LoRa-enabled net sales reached a record $58 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, up 31% sequentially and 58% year over year. Growth reflects wider adoption of LoRa across different applications, including smart homes, security systems and industrial monitoring. Management expects the business to maintain its momentum, with LoRa revenues projected to grow about 15% sequentially and 65% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

Semtech is expanding its LoRa portfolio to address more applications. Its LoRa Gen 4 platform supports higher data speeds while maintaining low power consumption and long-range connectivity. These features can support new uses in smart homes, security and industrial applications. For example, LoRa-enabled sensors can help monitor industrial equipment and support predictive maintenance. In public safety, the technology can also enable sensors to transmit audio for AI-based verification instead of sending simple alerts.

Amazon Sidewalk is another potential growth driver for Semtech's LoRa business. Following Ring's launch of a new range of LoRa-based sensors in the United States, Amazon Sidewalk is expanding internationally, starting with Canada and Mexico, while Europe, Australia and Japan are expected to follow. This expansion could help increase the use of LoRa-based devices in consumer applications through Amazon's network. Meanwhile, LoRa Plus is gaining traction in smart home and security markets, broadening the company's opportunities beyond traditional industrial and commercial use cases.

Strong momentum in LoRaWAN, LoRa Plus and Amazon Sidewalk can also support SMTC's future growth. Management expects LoRa revenues to grow at a rate above its previous 20% benchmark, supported by demand across these applications. With record revenues, new use cases and expanding distribution through Amazon Sidewalk, LoRa could become an increasingly important contributor to Semtech's overall growth.

SMTC's Valuation Reflects High Growth Expectations

SMTC is currently trading at a higher price-to-sales (P/S) multiple compared with the industry. SMTC's forward 12-month P/S ratio sits at 9.82X, higher than the industry's forward 12-month P/S ratio of 8.43X.

SMTC Forward 12-Month P/S Ratio

SMTC stock also trades at a higher P/S multiple compared with other industry peers, including Microchip Technology, ON Semiconductor and NXP Semiconductors. At present, Microchip Technology, ON Semiconductor and NXP Semiconductors have P/S multiples of 5.89X, 4.18X and 3.72X, respectively.

SMTC's rally reflects investor excitement about AI-related data center demand, putting it above industry and peers in terms of valuation, reflecting the high growth expectations of the company in the long term.

Conclusion: Buy SMTC Stock Right Now

Semtech is seeing strong demand for AI data center products, with the ramp-up of 1.6T solutions driving revenue growth and a strong backlog supporting future demand. The company's LoRa business is growing as adoption increases across smart homes, security and industrial applications. These factors support the outlook for continued growth. Further, the stock's valuation reflects high growth expectations, which are set to benefit from rising AI data center spending and wider adoption of LoRa technology.

Currently, SMTC sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here.

news.Title: ASML vs. SIMO: Which Chip Stock Has More Growth Potential Today?
news.Content:
ASML Holding N.V. ASML and Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO are two premier semiconductor firms focusing on advanced chip technologies and the broader semiconductor ecosystem. Both players are well-positioned to gain from growing demand for advanced computing, with ASML supplying the lithography equipment essential for manufacturing semiconductors and SIMO developing NAND flash controllers for SSDs and data storage applications.

ASML provides sophisticated hardware, software and systems that enable semiconductor manufacturers to produce increasingly smaller, faster and more energy-efficient chips. Its technologies are primarily used in the lithography stage of semiconductor manufacturing, in which complex circuit patterns are transferred onto silicon wafers.

Silicon Motion is a leading developer of microcontroller ICs for NAND flash storage devices. The semiconductor firm also designs, develops and markets high-performance, low-power semiconductor solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and other customers.

Let us try to analyze some of the competitive strengths and weaknesses of the companies to understand who is in a better position to maximize gains from the emerging market trends.

The Case for ASML

Rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is one of ASML's most powerful growth catalysts. Training and inference workloads require increasingly powerful and energy-efficient processors, which are accelerating the transition toward smaller process nodes and more advanced memory technologies. The ongoing investments and continued progress in AI technologies are further boosting demand for both advanced Logic and Memory chips. Semiconductor manufacturers are accelerating capacity expansion plans, resulting in stronger commitments across ASML's product portfolio.

ASML's decision to materially increase manufacturing capacity provides another indication of strengthening demand visibility. Based on strong customer commitments, the company plans to increase its 2027 Low-NA EUV capacity by approximately 30% from its 2026 capacity of roughly 65 systems. It is also evaluating another roughly 30% capacity increase for 2028. A similar expansion is underway for immersion DUV. ASML plans to raise capacity by around 30% in 2027 from a 2026 level of roughly 130 systems and is evaluating another 30% increase for 2028. Capacity expansion suggests that customers are providing ASML with higher visibility into their multi-year fab and technology plans.

However, management attributes the current demand environment primarily to AI-related investment and the resulting need for more advanced Logic and Memory capacity. Although this has produced unusually long order visibility for ASML, it makes the growth profile increasingly dependent on customers maintaining those expansion plans. A slower pace of customer investment would therefore affect both system demand and utilization of the larger production footprint ASML is preparing, resulting in elevated operational risks.

Story Continues

The Case for SIMO

Silicon Motion has established itself as the leading merchant supplier of client SSD (solid state drive) controllers to module makers, including most market leaders in the United States, Taiwan and China. The company believes that it is well-equipped to adapt to industry changes as it has collaborated with flash vendors to develop proprietary controller technology to overcome the existing weakness of 3D NAND and outshine peers. Silicon Motion has commenced initial sales of 3D SSD controllers to flash partners. It expects this controller to be a significant SSD controller growth driver for the next year, as NAND Flash partners' 3D capacity expands.

Silicon Motion operates a fabless business model, focusing on chip design while outsourcing manufacturing to foundries like TSMC. Consequently, the company has a low capital investment requirement as it does not need expensive fabrication plants, enabling it to adopt advanced manufacturing nodes quickly, leading to higher margins compared to integrated manufacturers. This, in turn, enables the company to focus on innovation and product development rather than manufacturing complexity. The key growth drivers for SIMO include AI and high-performance computing, cloud data centers, automotive storage, smartphones and mobile devices. Each of these end markets is growing fast and offers lucrative growth potential. Over the past 10 years, the company has shipped more than 5 billion controllers cumulatively – more than any other company in the world. Silicon Motion ships more than 750 million NAND controllers on average every year.

However, sluggishness in the global economy is likely to weigh on the company's wireless and broader semiconductor market. The demand for PCs and smartphones in the end market continues to be soft as numerous suppliers are focusing on reducing their inventory levels. The near-term price fluctuation in the PC market remains a concern. Silicon Motion continues to acquire a large number of companies. While this improves revenue opportunities, business mix and profitability, it adds to integration risks. Moreover, the semiconductor industry is highly dynamic as it is prone to swift technological changes, stiff competition from evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.

How Do Zacks Estimates Compare for ASML & SIMO?

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for ASML's 2026 sales implies year-over-year growth of 35.4%, while that for EPS indicates a surge of 56.9%. The EPS estimates have trended up 2.2% over the past 60 days.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for SIMO's 2026 sales indicates a year-over-year growth of 112.9%, while that for EPS suggests a rise of 214.4%. The EPS estimates have remained static over the past 60 days.

Price Performance & Valuation of ASML & SIMO

Over the past year, Silicon Motion has soared 194% compared with the industry's growth of 159.6%. ASML has gained 80.8% over the same period.

Silicon Motion looks more attractive than ASML from a valuation standpoint. Going by the price/sales ratio, ASML's shares currently trade at 11.79 forward sales, higher than 3.77 for SIMO.

ASML or SIMO: Which is a Better Pick?

ASML currently carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), while SIMO carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here .

With a superior Zacks Rank and better fundamentals, Silicon Motion appears to be relatively better placed than ASML. Consequently, SIMO is a better investment option at the moment.

news.Title: Brokers Suggest Investing in Lam Research (LRCX): Read This Before Placing a Bet
news.Content:
The recommendations of Wall Street analysts are often relied on by investors when deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold a stock. Media reports about these brokerage-firm-employed (or sell-side) analysts changing their ratings often affect a stock's price. Do they really matter, though?

Let's take a look at what these Wall Street heavyweights have to say about Lam Research (LRCX) before we discuss the reliability of brokerage recommendations and how to use them to your advantage.

Lam Research currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.51, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 34 brokerage firms. An ABR of 1.51 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.

Of the 34 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 23 are Strong Buy and four are Buy. Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 67.7% and 11.8% of all recommendations.

Brokerage Recommendation Trends for LRCX

Check price target & stock forecast for Lam Research here>>>

While the ABR calls for buying Lam Research, it may not be wise to make an investment decision solely based on this information. Several studies have shown limited to no success of brokerage recommendations in guiding investors to pick stocks with the best price increase potential.

Are you wondering why? The vested interest of brokerage firms in a stock they cover often results in a strong positive bias of their analysts in rating it. Our research shows that for every "Strong Sell" recommendation, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations.

In other words, their interests aren't always aligned with retail investors, rarely indicating where the price of a stock could actually be heading. Therefore, the best use of this information could be validating your own research or an indicator that has proven to be highly successful in predicting a stock's price movement.

With an impressive externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool, the Zacks Rank, which classifies stocks into five groups, ranging from Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) to Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), is a reliable indicator of a stock's near-term price performance. So, validating the Zacks Rank with ABR could go a long way in making a profitable investment decision.

Zacks Rank Should Not Be Confused With ABR

Although both Zacks Rank and ABR are displayed in a range of 1--5, they are different measures altogether.

Broker recommendations are the sole basis for calculating the ABR, which is typically displayed in decimals (such as 1.28). The Zacks Rank, on the other hand, is a quantitative model designed to harness the power of earnings estimate revisions. It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.

Story Continues

Analysts employed by brokerage firms have been and continue to be overly optimistic with their recommendations. Since the ratings issued by these analysts are more favorable than their research would support because of the vested interest of their employers, they mislead investors far more often than they guide.

In contrast, the Zacks Rank is driven by earnings estimate revisions. And near-term stock price movements are strongly correlated with trends in earnings estimate revisions, according to empirical research.

In addition, the different Zacks Rank grades are applied proportionately to all stocks for which brokerage analysts provide current-year earnings estimates. In other words, this tool always maintains a balance among its five ranks.

Another key difference between the ABR and Zacks Rank is freshness. The ABR is not necessarily up-to-date when you look at it. But, since brokerage analysts keep revising their earnings estimates to account for a company's changing business trends, and their actions get reflected in the Zacks Rank quickly enough, it is always timely in indicating future price movements.

Is LRCX Worth Investing In?

In terms of earnings estimate revisions for Lam Research, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has increased 0.2% over the past month to $9.34.

Analysts' growing optimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher, could be a legitimate reason for the stock to soar in the near term.

The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) for Lam Research. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

Therefore, the Buy-equivalent ABR for Lam Research may serve as a useful guide for investors.

news.Title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Meta Platform, NVIDIA, Palantir, Cisco, SanDisk and Qualcomm
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – October 12, 2026 – Today, Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights Meta Platform META, NVIDIA NVDA, Palantir PLTR, Cisco CSCO, SanDisk SNDK and Qualcomm QCOM.

Navigating the AI Boom: "Bubble" Is NOT a 4-Letter Word

The AI Bull/Bear Debate

The artificial intelligence boom has divided Wall Street investors into two distinct groups:

1.      Bulls who believe artificial intelligence is a transformational technology and think the massive CAPEX spending is logical, leading to years of profitability for AI-native companies.

2.      Bears who believe that the massive CAPEX spending will lead to a poor return on investment and believe that much of the AI spending is "circular."

In my view, rather than taking a one-sided stance, investors are best served by exercising some nuance when analyzing the AI market. From a bullish perspective, I have no doubt that AI is transformational. For instance, the other day, I plugged a 50-slide PowerPoint presentation into Meta Platform's "Muse" and gave it prompts.

First, Muse took four years of data I provided and created a clean, accurate graphical representation. Then, I simply prompted the agentic AI platform to "Optimize" my slide show. Within seconds, Muse corrected any grammatical errors, perfected my layouts, and suggested some improvements. Before AI, optimizing this PowerPoint presentation would probably take two to three hours.

Conversely, history says that although the AI buildout is the largest in history, it will eventually end badly, because all bull markets do. Whether it was the railroad bull market of the late 1800s, the post-World War 2 industrial boom, or the internet boom of the late 1990s, the market is undefeated, and all bull markets end. In fact, most leading stocks in these eras fell 50% or more from their highs, never to recover.

The Bears are Loud

Since the U.S. stock market began trading, one certainty has been that, in the long run, equity markets tend to rise. In other words, if you look at a 50-year chart of the S&P 500, it trends from the bottom left to the top right. Nevertheless, many industry-specific booms and busts have occurred during that time.

One interesting thing that I have noticed on social media is that "shock jocks" often garner more attention than bulls. Perhaps this phenomenon is due to the popularity of the Hollywood smash hit film "The Big Short," or perhaps it is just human nature. Regardless, if you log into financial Twitter, chances are you will see bears beating their chest, using data points to connect the current AI bull market to that of the late 1990s or 1929.

Story Continues

"A bubble is any asset that goes up...that you don't own." ~ Art Hogan

But the bearishness isn't limited to retail investors. This morning, I read a headline that famous investor Ray Dalio "Warns AI is a classic bubble nearing its bursting point." Michael Burry, who became famous for his "Big Short" during the financial crisis, became bearish on AI leaders in late 2025. While these investors are well known and highly respected, history shows that their market calls are far from gospel.

For example, Ray Dalio has warned of a structural debt crisis and market downturn for the past 12 years. Although the ballooning debt is certainly a concern, the S&P 500 Index was higher in 10 of the past 12 years on a total return basis, registering a 278% return. Meanwhile, AI-related stocks Michael Burry warned about in 2025, like NVIDIA and Palantir , recently printed fresh all-time highs.

Bubble is Not a Four-Letter Word

In most Wall Street circles, the word bubble has a negative connotation. Because a bubble suggests that stock prices detach from fundamentals and ultimately come crashing down, such a reputation is partially earned. However, another way to view bubbles is as a period when stock prices rise rapidly over a short time.

"When I see a bubble forming, I rush in to buy, adding fuel to the fire. That is not irrational." ~George Soros

I view bubbles as a rare time to generate a lot of portfolio alpha in a short time.

"But What If I am Too Late and the Bubble Bursts?"

The question is, "Where in the cycle are we?" Five data points suggest that the market may just be entering its explosive phase, including:

1. Historical Precedent: The Nasdaq 100 precedent after the Netscape vs. ChatGPT launch suggests the meat of the equity move may be just starting. Thus far, the precedent is eerily similar.

2. Valuations: The trailing P/E for the Nasdaq 100 is currently ~29.5x. At the March 2000 Dot-com peak, the Nasdaq 100 trailing P/E was over 100x for many leaders. Cisco (CSCO), the market leader of that cycle, topped with a P/E of ~200x. NVIDIA, the current AI leader, has a P/E of just 34.67x.

3. Lack of IPO Animal Spirits: In 2026, there have been 251 IPOs. Conversely, in 2000, there were 446 IPOs. While future IPOs like Anthropic and OpenAI already generate billions in revenue, many dot-com IPOs were pre-revenue.

4. Price Action is Not Euphoric: In 1999, Qualcomm, the highest-flying internet stock, gained 2,600%. By early 2000, the stock continued its uptrend before forming a climax top pattern and topping. While AI stocks like SanDisk have seen similarly strong returns, key differences remain. Qualcomm shares were stretched more than 200% above the 200-day moving average, were near-vertical, and exhibited several classic overnight "exhaustion gaps."

Conversely, SanDisk shares are just 47% above the 200-day moving average and have been basing since July – not exactly euphoric.

5. Retail Sentiment is Bearish: Historically, bubbles burst when retail investors work themselves into a frenzy. It happened with the real estate bust of 2008 (when many people began flipping real estate), and the internet bubble of 2000 (when many people became day traders). Today, retail sentiment is in the gutter. According to the American Association of Individual Investors, bearish sentiment is currently higher than bullish sentiment.

Bottom Line

The constant labeling of AI as a "bubble" shouldn't deter investors from participating in one of history's most transformative technological shifts. While market excesses and cyclical corrections are inevitable, today's AI expansion rests on real revenue generation, reasonable valuations compared to previous manias, and a foundation of widespread institutional skepticism rather than euphoric retail mania.

news.Title: Here's How Much a $1000 Investment in Cisco Systems Made 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
news.Content:
For most investors, how much a stock's price changes over time is important. This factor can impact your investment portfolio as well as help you compare investment results across sectors and industries.

The fear of missing out, or FOMO, also plays a factor in investing, especially with particular tech giants, as well as popular consumer-facing stocks.

What if you'd invested in Cisco Systems (CSCO) ten years ago? It may not have been easy to hold on to CSCO for all that time, but if you did, how much would your investment be worth today?

Cisco Systems' Business In-Depth

With that in mind, let's take a look at Cisco Systems' main business drivers.

Cisco Systems enables enterprises and service providers to deliver secure connectivity from workplaces to data centers worldwide. The company delivers a unified architecture with integrated, end-to-end solutions that help customers simplify complex challenges. Cisco incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) across product portfolios spanning Networking, Security, Collaboration and Observability. In fiscal 2026, these categories represented 71.8%, 17%, 8.9% and 2.3% of product revenues, respectively.

Headquartered in San Jose, CA, Cisco reported revenues of $63.33 billion in fiscal 2026. Product and Services contributed 76.3% and 23.7%, respectively, to revenues. Americas, EMEA and APJC generated 59.7%, 26.2% and 14.1% of total revenues in fiscal 2026, respectively.

Networking comprises core networking technologies, including switching, routing, wireless and servers. The switching portfolio encompasses campus switching and data center switching offerings. Campus switching offerings include the Catalyst 9000 family of switches, Meraki cloud-managed switches and Cisco 9350 and Cisco 9610 smart switches built on Cisco Silicon One. Data center switching offerings include the Nexus 9000 series and Cisco N9300 series smart switches that embed Cisco Hypershield, the company's cloud-native and AI-powered approach to highly distributed security for AI-scale data centers.

Security consists of Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Threat Intelligence, Detection, and Response (TIDR) solutions. The Splunk platform and security offerings are part of Cisco's TIDR capabilities.

Collaboration comprises Webex Suite, Collaboration Devices, Contact Center and CPaaS. It offers end-to-end collaboration solutions that can be delivered on-premises, from the cloud or within hybrid cloud environments. Observability comprises network assurance through ThousandEyes, monitoring and analytics, and observability suites, including Splunk Observability and AppDynamics.

Cisco competes with companies such as Amazon Web Services, Arista Networks, Broadcom, Ciena, CrowdStrike Holdings, Dell, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Microsoft, Nokia, Nvidia, Palo Alto Networks, RingCentral, Zoom Video Communications and Zscaler.

Story Continues

Bottom Line

Anyone can invest, but building a successful investment portfolio requires research, patience, and a little bit of risk. So, if you had invested in Cisco Systems, ten years ago, you're likely feeling pretty good about your investment today.

A $1000 investment made in October 2016 would be worth $3,762.00, or a 276.20% gain, as of October 12, 2026, according to our calculations. Investors should note that this return excludes dividends but includes price increases.

Compare this to the S&P 500's rally of 262.70% and gold's return of 221.18% over the same time frame.

Analysts are anticipating more upside for CSCO.

Cisco's prospects are benefiting from broad demand across networking, security and collaboration. AI infrastructure orders, integrated silicon and an end-of-support refresh opportunity support a multi-year networking cycle, while newer security products and Splunk's recovery broaden the growth base. Cisco also retains operating leverage and continues to return cash to shareholders. Offsetting these positives, a hardware-led revenue mix is expected to limit gross-margin expansion, while services recovery should remain gradual. Competition across networking and security still requires sustained product execution. Acquisition exposure and an elevated valuation leave less room for disappointment. The breadth of durable growth drivers outweighs these execution, margin and valuation risks, supporting the Outperform recommendation.

The stock is up 5.58% over the past four weeks, and no earnings estimate has gone lower in the past two months, compared to 8 higher, for fiscal 2026. The consensus estimate has moved up as well.

news.Title: 群益投信看Q4：獲利定方向、AI進入驗證，聚焦DUO策略
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-12 18:41:28 丁于珊 發佈

群益投信今(12)日舉行2026年第四季投資展望記者會，群益投信表示，利率變化仍將牽動市場風險偏好，但隨AI應用加速擴散、企業營運續旺，多頭格局可望延續，相對短期波動反而提供重新檢視與布局的契機。面對機會與挑戰並存的環境，投資人可採用「DUO」高效投資策略，以多工處理（Multi-tasking）的理財思維進行股債多元配置，掌握科技趨勢與成長契機，同時建立收益與防禦機制，靈活因應市場變化，打造攻守兼備的投資組合，在震盪中穩健前行。

今年第三季雖受通膨升溫、AI變現疑慮影響，全球金融市場呈現高檔震盪，但整體經濟展現韌性，基本面、企業獲利與資金動能同步增強，評價面經過回檔修正後回到合理區間，為後續行情奠定基礎。群益投信建議投資人，第四季可採取「DUO」投資策略，掌握科技趨勢與成長契機

群益投信指出，「DUO」高效投資策略中的「D」代表 Diversify 多元分散風險，今年來全球金融市場震盪頻繁，穩健型投資人可透過「先固息、後增益」架構，利用多重資產基金、目標風險組合平衡基金，或結合具有高息優勢的債券基金及ETF，像是金融債基金、非投等債基金、優先順位非投等債基金、短天期ESG BBB級投等債ETF、優選非投等債ETF等，以獲得穩建息收並降低投組波動。

「U」為Upside Trend 掌握上行趨勢，在AI需求強勁與應用落地，以及大廠資本支出加速下，台美科技供應鏈獲利維持高成長，成為推升台股、美股向上的核心動能。投資人可透過主動式台股ETF、台股基金、主動式美股ETF、市值型美股ETF、科技型美股ETF、美國成長股基金，以參與AI核心商機。

「O」則是Opportunity 捕捉潛力機會，尤其印度受惠於政策利多、內需強勁，有利股市重返成長格局，有意參與補漲行情的投資人，可適度配置印度相關股票基金。此外，日本自首相高市早苗上任後，積極推動各項改革政策，並邁向利率正常化，為日本經濟注入新動能。看好日股紅利的投資人，不妨透過以日股為核心部位的亞股基金來掌握新多頭行情。

整體來看，「DUO」高效投資策略協助投資人抵禦波動，同時掌握潛在商機，以從容應對重啟升息後的經濟新局，同時達成資產穩健增值的理財目標。而針對全球總經方面，群益環球金綻雙喜基金經理人許書銘表示，中東戰事推升油價並加劇通膨壓力，促使聯準會重啟升息，主要央行也轉趨鷹派，全球進入高利率維持更久的新局面。不過歷史經驗顯示，升息對股市影響往往呈現「短空長多」，尤其在AI投資週期加速下，全球製造業PMI持續擴張，有助企業營運改善。預期企業獲利的強勁表現可望支撐升息初期的估值修正，待市場消化政策衝擊後，投資焦點仍將回到基本面。

許書銘進一步指出，面對經濟發展穩健、貨幣政策轉向的環境，第四季操作仍以股優於債為主，在股市布局上，隨著AI資本支出加速，可鎖定獲利能見度最高的科技成長股、財務體質良好的大型股，以及受惠於半導體超級週期的新興亞股。債券配置上，因應利率環境變化，短債表現相對受惠，可善用具收益優勢的非投等債、新興債建立穩健現金流來源，並強化投組防禦力。

在美股投資方面，群益美國科技巨頭ETF（009824）經理人李晉含指出，雖然市場面臨升息與資金成本提高的挑戰，但企業獲利的強勁增長足以抵銷估值壓力，市場表現依然穩健，今年前三季標普500指數上漲11.8%，屢創新高，同時企業獲利持續上修，使未來12個月本益比從年初的22.2倍降至19.1倍，顯示整體評價仍屬合理。

然而，隨著利率走高，市場將更嚴格檢視AI商業化進程、自由現金流與變現能力，市場將進入企業層級的成長淘汰賽。李晉含提到，第四季市場將從「買哪個市場」進一步轉向「買哪些公司」，企業是否能承受更高資金成本、維持獲利成長，將成為重要選股標準；而後續可關注債券殖利率、油價走勢，操作上也須留意第四季財測與市場廣度變化。

產業布局上，李晉含表示，在市場最為關切的AI領域，在模型突破、硬體擴建、資本回收與代理商業化同時發展下，市場注意力形成四層重疊，角度也自能否建成延伸至能否應用、收費並留下現金；現階段來看，市場對接下來最高成長預期仍集中於AI基礎設施，相關硬體獲利可望延續，料為資金匯集之處，非電族群則可留意包括金融、航太與能源，以掌握個股輪動下的投資契機。

此外，美國期中選舉、能源與地緣政治，以及利率與償債壓力也將成為市場主要障礙。李晉含認為，高利率雖然可能壓抑市場估值，但若企業獲利成長速度夠快，仍有機會抵銷利率上升的影響，因此仍看好第四季美股具備支撐力道；整體來看，預期第四季將會呈現「獲利決定方向、AI進入驗證」的階段。
